• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. What you will do:
• Leading cross functional teams as a process expert tasked with technology transfers (process design and scale-up) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning, implementation, control to completion in alignment with defined project goals.
• Serve as the key interface between the process donor (customer or process development) and operations, to ensure scalability and suitability of the manufacturing processes for commercial-scale production.
• Securing success during technology transfer by applying procedures and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control.
• Responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory and GMP requirements.
• Responsible for execution of risk analyses for the manufacturing processes under GMP.
• Interacting directly with customers and stakeholders during tech transfer, campaign preparation, execution and closure, including daily reporting of batch status and performance.
• Ensuring timely compilation of process related deviations, change requests and campaign reports.
• Compiling CMC sections and technical content of validation reports
• Develop and implement standardized MSAT procedures and processes.
• Driving continuous improvements of the manufacturing processes.
• Evaluating and driving innovative trends within the respective area of expertise. What we are looking for:
• Master's degree, PhD or equivalent experience is a plus
• Preferred area of study: Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related subject areas
• More than 5 years of experience in DSP for the manufacture of APIs or process development
• Deep understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice of APIs
• Strong scientific and technical acumen
• Fluency in English and German
• Strong leadership skills
• Very good communication to interact with various stakeholders

descriptionByLocale.it:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join the PADI team and help unlock operational performance by connecting data, processes, and people. Working at the heart of Operations and Process Development, you’ll collaborate across functions to solve real manufacturing and process challenges through analytics and innovation. This is your opportunity to drive smarter decisions and shape the future of data-driven manufacturing. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you’ll do:
• Build trusted, analytics-ready datasets by integrating, contextualizing, and structuring operational data from systems such as PI, MES, ELN, instrument platforms, and manufacturing data sources.
• Work closely with mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand how operational data is generated, used, and interpreted within real manufacturing and GMP workflows.
• Analyze process trends, variability, bottlenecks, and performance drivers across batches, campaigns, and workflows using statistical and analytical techniques.
• Develop operational dashboards, analytical views, and process intelligence solutions used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Manufacturing, QA, and Operations teams
• Translate complex operational and manufacturing datasets into actionable insights and improvement opportunities that support process robustness and operational performance.
• Support GMP deliverables and reporting activities while identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve underlying data and operational workflows.
• Improve operational data quality, traceability, contextualization, and usability to enable scalable analytics and reliable decision-making.
• Collaborate closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, IT, and global data teams to deliver scalable, operationally relevant, and production-ready data and analytics solutions. What we are looking for:
• Strong passion for analyzing complex process and manufacturing data and translating it into actionable insights and scalable solutions
• Ability to think beyond reporting and leverage data to improve process understanding, operational performance, and decision-making
• Experience collaborating with manufacturing and process teams, ideally within mammalian production environments
• Strong interest in working at the intersection of process science, operational analytics, and digital transformation
• Good understanding of how data is generated, structured, and utilized within operational environments
• Ability to clearly communicate complex analyses and translate them into practical recommendations for diverse stakeholders
• Hands-on mindset with a collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork Technical Requirements:
• Experience with process analytics, operational analytics, and industrial data environments
• Practical skills in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, and data visualization
• Understanding of data pipelines and ETL processes
• Experience with tools such as Seeq, SIMCA, Statistica, Power BI, PI System, Azure, Git, or comparable platforms Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in a CDMO environment or knowledge of mammalian manufacturing / bioprocess development
• Interest in process behavior, variability, GMP-related support, and continuous improvement About Lonza: At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Assumiamo (Senior) Program Manager per aderire alla nostra organizzazione Integrata Biologics. In questo ruolo, sarete il collegamento principale tra Lonza e i nostri clienti, leader team interfunzionali attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto completo, dal contratto alla produzione e alla consegna di GMP. Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni Cosa farai:
• Guidare e fornire programmi ai clienti attraverso il loro ciclo di vita completo, dal trasferimento tecnologico alla produzione e alla chiusura di progetti GMP, garantendo qualità, tempi e convenienza.
• Agire come partner affidabile e punto di contatto principale per i clienti, promuovere la comunicazione trasparente e la collaborazione a lungo termine.
• Ispirare e coordinare squadre diverse e funzionali in un ambiente matrice, promuovendo la proprietà condivisa e le prestazioni elevate.
• Guidare il successo del programma gestendo la portata, le linee temporali e finanziarie, allineando con gli obiettivi strategici di business.
• Collaborare tra le funzioni per gestire i cambiamenti di portata, sostenere le strategie commerciali e contribuire alle opportunità future.
• Identificare e affrontare i rischi in modo proattivo, garantendo una risoluzione dei problemi e un miglioramento continuo.
• Membri del team di supporto e mentore, promuovendo una cultura di apprendimento, inclusione e sviluppo professionale. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Laurea in Chimica, Biologia, Biotecnologia, o un campo correlato; PhD è un plus.
• Esperienza nella gestione di progetti o programmi, idealmente in farmacia o CDMO.
• Forte comprensione dei fattori tecnici, commerciali e organizzativi.
• Prova capacità di guidare squadre interfunzionali e fornire programmi complessi.
• Conoscenza della produzione di GMP e sviluppo di sostanze stupefacenti.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione e leadership.
• Fluente in inglese; il tedesco è un plus. Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Am Standort Visp bietet Lonza im Sustainability Team einen Praktikumsplatz im Rahmen des praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudiums (PiBS) in Zusammenarbeit mit der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) an. Das PiBS-Modell ermöglicht Maturandinnen und Maturanden den direkten Einstieg in ein Bachelorstudium im MINT-Bereich, ohne vorgängiges Praxisjahr. Während des Studiums arbeiten die Studierenden 40 – 100% im Unternehmen (je nach Studiumsmodell) und besuchen parallel die Lehrveranstaltungen an der HSLU. So verbinden sie Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Als PiBS-Studierende/r bei Lonza sammeln Sie wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem internationalen Life-Science-Umfeld und arbeiten aktiv an Projekten im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourceneffizienz mit, während Sie ihr Bachelorstudium an der Hochschule Luzern – Technik & Architektur absolvieren. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Allgemeine Tätigkeiten im Bereit Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenschonung mit Fokus auf Abwasserminimierung und CO2-Emissionen
• Mitwirken im Site Sustainability Team Visp zur Projekt Identifizierung und Umsetzung
• Bearbeitung von Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt, um Energien und Abwasserströme zu minimieren
• Technische Anlagenoptimierung mit Fokus auf Verbrennungs- und Verwertungsanalgen sowie Abwasserreinigungsanlagen
• Evaluierung von technisch und ökonomischen Machbarkeiten am Standort, um mittel- und langfristige Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen Was wir suchen
• Maturant/in mit Studienplatz an der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) im PiBS (Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium) in den Studienrichtungen Energie- und Umwelttechnik sowie Maschinentechnik
• Interesse an den Themen Nachhaltigkeit, CO2-Reduktion und allgemeiner Ressourcenschonung
• Proaktive, selbständige und flexible Arbeitsweise
• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache. Englischkenntnisse vorteilhaft Über Lonza: Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. What you’ll get:
• ● An agile career and dynamic working culture
• ● An inclusive and ethical workplace
• ● Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• ● A variety of benefits dependent on role and location What you’ll do:
• ● Manages as teamlead the personnel activities of 6x20k DSP production staff with overall responsibility of the shift teams with regard to safety, quality and on-time-in full delivery.
• ● Is responsible together with the Head of DSP for production planning, problem solving and the realization of innovation projects.
• ● Is accountable for the performance and results of the shift teams together with the shift teamleads.
• ● Responsible for the safety culture, i.e. the general work safety as well as the safe behaviour of the shiftteams
• ● Responsible for the training concept and execution of the shiftteams together with the shift teamsleads and the technical trainer.
• ● Manages the Long-term and cost-optimized planning of shift teams. What we’re looking for:
• ● B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in scientific field.
• ● Solid work experience of 2-5 years in the GMP controlled pharmaceutical/biotech industry is a prerequisite.
• ● Proven leadership and people management skills. Capable of managing multiple points of view and building partnerships. Embracing Lonza’s core leadership principles.
• ● Comprehensive knowledge of production processes and interrelationships in a large production area with detailed knowledge of all process steps and systems
• ● Experience in training execution and documentation.
• ● Fluency in English (spoken and written) is required. Preferably, at least B1 Level (spoken and written) in German. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Lonza in Visp is looking for a Program Management Analyst (f/m/d). You will engage with and provide clarity to the Program Management Team by translating the data within the data collection tools into informative consolidated views. These views will become essential to drive data-driven action and will be the framework for your analytical advice and support using language that can be easily understood by non-technical colleagues. You will also ensure all business critical reporting is up-to-date and available in a timely manner with a role of data integrity ambassador for the site, acting as a point of contact for first stage resolution of data integrity issues. You will use your strong business management and financial tool background together with your analysis expertise in transforming data into information by constructing new and tailoring old tools in our business and as such will have a high level of direct exposure to our Senior Leadership Team. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Support and lead Projects / initiatives to transform business management tools to deliver clear information
• SAP Technical Support
• Update existing reporting & dashboards
• Work with Finance supporting monthly revenue reconciliation
• Organise meetings and take on additional tasks as needed to give support to the team What we are looking for:
• Academic degree with scientific background in Business/ Finance or similar
• SAP experience preferred
• High level with MS Office suite required (especially Excel and Power Point), Power BI experience preferred
• Business Tools like Planview or IBP are a nice-to-have
• Excellent prioritization, organizational & planning skills
• Ability to work in team and independently
• Pharma knowledge desirable About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join a dynamic, international team to perform routine analytical testing of Drug Products in a GMP environment, independently executing physical, chemical, and bioanalytical methods while ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with GDP and SOPs. Take ownership of key lab activities (e.g. HPLC, CE-SDS, UV, ELISA) and play an active role in building a new laboratory setup—bringing precision, curiosity, and a quality-first mindset. Check out Your Career in Drug Product Services at Lonza! This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits What you will do:
• Responsible to independently execute, coordinate and review physico-chemical and biochemical assays under cGMP according to existing method SOPs (e.g. compendial testing/content/identity/purity for small molecules, biologics/large molecules)
• Responsible to document assay execution under cGMP following Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and flag relevant observations to the supervisor for further assessment
• Accountable for execution of operational tasks in the lab e.g. mobile phase preparations, calibration of equipment, adherence to and maintenance of 6S, consumable management and support of equipment maintenance.
• Support of validation and transfer activities in frame of new project introduction cGMP standards for audit readiness and supports onsite customer/regulatory audits
• Assists in investigation/troubleshooting for assigned tasks What we are looking for:
• First hands-on experience in analytical methodologies like e.g. pH measurement, UV-Vis, turbidity (experience with HPLC, Elisa or similar technologies are a plus)
• Experience with GMP is a plus
• Apprenticeship or or equivalent in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field
• Fluency in written and spoken English, German is an asset

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein/e Prjoject Lead QC gesucht. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Abschätzung des Aufwands für Kunden in ausführlichen Projektplänen (zeitliche Planung, Ablaufplanung, vorläufige Abklärungen, Arbeitsergebnisse, Aufgleisen der Dokumentation und Einbeziehung der Qualitätssicherung)
• Koordination von Projekten und Betreuung der technischen Realisierung der Projekte während des Methodentransfers und anschliessende Beratung
• Berichterstattung über den Fortschritt eines Projektes und Eskalationen von Angelegenheiten, wenn dies erforderlich ist
• Initiierung und Fertigstellung von notwendigen prozessbezogenen Change Controls, Deviations und Laboruntersuchungen
• Verantwortlich für das Ausführen und die Organisation eines angemessenen Trainings von Mitarbeitenden innerhalb der QC, um die cGMP Compliance auf der Betriebsebene sicherzustellen
• Proaktives nachverfolgen von Entwicklungsaktivitäten innerhalb der zutreffenden Disziplin, zusammen mit dem Austausch von Wissen innerhalb der QC Organisation
• Erstellen, Überarbeitung und Review von cGMP Dokumenten (SOP`s, Qualitätsanweisungen, Protokollen, Berichten...), basierend auf dem Standardformat für Aktivitäten innerhalb der Qualitätskontrolle
• Nimmt an projektbezogenen Audits teil, falls anwendbar
• Schnittstelle zwischen den QC Angestellten und Auftragslaboren, um mögliche Verbesserungsvorschläge und deren Implementierung zusammen mit den Managern QC zu besprechen Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• PhD (Doktorat) in Chemie, Chemieingenieurwesen, Biochemie, Biologie, oder äquivalente Ausbildung; oder Bachelor, Master in einer entsprechenden Disziplin, mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
• Fortgeschrittene, wissenschaftliche Expertise auf dem Gebiet der Analytischen Chemie
• Fundierte, regulatorische (GMP & ISO 9001) Kenntnisse
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch
• IT Kenntnisse (inkl. QC relevanter Software wie LIMS, CDS, DMS, etc.)
• Change readiness
• Team player
• Kundenorientierung Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Unisciti al nostro team come principale scienziato associato - Sviluppo analitico 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp e contribuire a garantire la qualità e la sicurezza dei farmaci di domani. In questo ruolo pratico e basato sul sito, applicare tecnologie analitiche avanzate, collaborare cross-funzionalmente e guidare progetti ad alto impatto in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo. Se siete appassionati di scienza e pronti a fare la differenza, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza. Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni
• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. Il nostro elenco completo dei vantaggi locali su misura in Visp può essere trovato su https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Cosa farai:
• Servire come rappresentante AD sui team di progetto preclinici, coordinare con le PMI interne in tutte le fasi del progetto
• Possedere la consegna in tempo reale delle fasi di progetto assegnate e fungere da punto di contatto primario per tutte le richieste dei clienti relative agli argomenti AD
• Sostenere il team di progetto commerciale nello sviluppo di proposte e dichiarazioni di lavoro
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo del processo per semplificare i flussi di lavoro cross-department e consentire l'implementazione efficiente dei requisiti di progetto
• Atto come PMI per i metodi analitici designati, tra cui la revisione e l'interpretazione dei dati, le principali indagini di laboratorio e la risoluzione dei problemi
• Identificare le opportunità di innovazione nel settore delle competenze e promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Grado (Bachelor, Master o PhD) in biologia, biochimica o area tematica comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale rilevante
• Esperienza nell'analisi delle proteine, metodi fisico-chimici (ad esempio HPLC, LC‐MS, icIEF), analisi biochimiche (ad esempio ELISA, SPR), e/o tecniche di biologia molecolare (ad esempio qPCR)
• Esperienza ideale con sistemi IT/OT per laboratori analitici, come i quaderni di laboratorio elettronici, Empower, Softmax Pro ecc.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è dedicata alle persone che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. All'interno del team Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) embedded direttamente in Operations, costruiamo l'infrastruttura di dati pronta alla produzione che collega i dati di processo, esecuzione e sviluppo in una fondazione coerente e affidabile utilizzata quotidianamente da MSAT, Process Development, Operations e team di dati globali. Stiamo cercando un Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence per progettare, costruire e gestire questa base di dati e supportare l'utilizzo affidabile e scalabile dei dati operativi tra i team Cosa farai:
• Progettazione, costruzione e gestione di datadotti automatizzati che integrano archivi di dati distribuiti e database di sistemi operativi grezzi, tra cui storici (PI), MES, ELN e dati degli strumenti, in una coerente base di dati operativi end-to-end.
• Sostituire la gestione manuale dei dati, basata su file con flussi di dati regolati, versioneti e tracciabili che si estendono all'uso operativo quotidiano.
• Implementare e applicare controlli di qualità dei dati, regole di convalida e monitoraggio per garantire l'affidabilità dei dati in scala in un ambiente operativo.
• Fornire set di dati analitici (strumenti puliti, semantici coerenti, dati allineati a tempo) a BI a valle, livelli di analisi e modellazione avanzati che supportano il processo decisionale operativo.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con MSAT, Sviluppo dei processi, Automazione, QA, IT e team di dati globali per allineare modelli di dati, definizioni e modelli di integrazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Migliorare costantemente le prestazioni delle tubazioni, la robustezza e la manutenbilità in linea con le priorità operative. Chi sei?
• Pensi in condotte, schemi e modalità di fallimento, non file e soluzioni manuali.
• Progetta la ripetibilità, l'osservanza e la scala in ambienti dove l'affidabilità è importante.
• Sei comodo lavorare su sistemi OT, MES e piattaforme di dati cloud.
• Si prende la proprietà end-to-end, dai sistemi sorgente ai consumatori di analisi.
• Semplifichi i complessi paesaggi di dati operativi senza perdere dettagli di processo critici. Cosa porti:
• Elaborazione e gestione dei dati di produzione in ambienti operativi o industriali.
• Forte competenza SQL e esperienza ottimizzando le query per i carichi di lavoro operativi.
• Esperienza comprovata con ETL / ELT data di gestione dei processi e dell'esecuzione.
• Esposizione manuale agli storici (PI), MES, dati degli strumenti o sistemi OT simili.
• Solida comprensione della qualità dei dati, lignaggio, tracciabilità e governance idealmente negli ambienti regolamentati (GxP).
• Esperienza con piattaforme di dati cloud, preferibilmente Azure, tra cui la costruzione e la gestione di datadotti (Azure Data Factory), soluzioni di archiviazione dati (Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage), e controllo delle versioni tramite Git.
• Lo sfondo in dati biofarmaci, di produzione o di gestione è fortemente preferito.
• Istruzione: Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, o un campo tecnico relativo preferito — l'esperienza operativa equivalente sarà considerato. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we build production-ready data infrastructure that connects process, execution, and development data into a coherent and trusted foundation used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global data teams. We are looking for a Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence to design, build, and operate this data foundation and support reliable, scalable use of operational data across teams What You Will Do:
• Design, build, and operate automated data pipelines integrating distributed file-based data stores and raw operational system databases, including historians (PI), MES, ELN and instrument data, into a coherent, end-to-end operational data foundation.
• Replace manual, file-based data handling with governed, versioned and traceable data flows that stand up to daily operational use.
• Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring to ensure data reliability at scale in an operational environment.
• Deliver analytics-ready datasets (clean schemas, consistent semantics, time-aligned data) to downstream BI, advanced analytics and modeling layers supporting operational decision-making.
• Work closely with MSAT, Process Development, Automation, QA, IT and global data teams to align data models, definitions and integration patterns across the organization.
• Continuously improve pipeline performance, robustness and maintainability in line with operational priorities. Who You Are:
• You think in pipelines, schemas and failure modes, not files and manual workarounds.
• You design repeatability, observability and scale in environments where reliability matters.
• You are comfortable working across OT systems, MES, and cloud data platforms.
• You take end-to-end ownership, from source systems to analytics consumers.
• You simplify complex operational data landscapes without losing critical process detail. What You Bring:
• Hands-on experience building and operating production data pipelines in operational or industrial environments.
• Strong SQL expertise and experience optimizing queries for operational workloads.
• Proven experience with ETL / ELT pipelines handling process and execution data.
• Hands-on exposure to historians (PI), MES, instrument data, or similar OT systems.
• Solid understanding of data quality, lineage, traceability, and governance ideally in regulated (GxP) environments.
• Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Azure, including building and managing data pipelines (Azure Data Factory), data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage), and version control using Git.
• Background in biopharma, manufacturing, or operations data is strongly preferred.
• Education: Degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related technical field preferred — equivalent operational experience will be considered. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble, de concevoir des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin. Au sein de l'équipe Processus Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI), intégrée directement aux Opérations, nous construisons une infrastructure de données prête à la production qui relie les données de processus, d'exécution et de développement en une base cohérente et fiable utilisée quotidiennement par les équipes MSAT, Process Development, Operations et Global Data. Nous recherchons un Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence pour concevoir, construire et exploiter cette base de données et soutenir une utilisation fiable et évolutive des données opérationnelles entre les équipes Ce que vous ferez :
• Concevoir, construire et exploiter des pipelines de données automatisés intégrant des stockages de données distribués basés sur des fichiers et des bases de données de systèmes opérationnels bruts, y compris des historiens (PI), des MES, des ELN et des données d'instruments, en une base de données opérationnelles de bout en bout cohérente.
• Remplacer le traitement manuel des données par des flux de données régis, en version et traçables qui résistent à une utilisation opérationnelle quotidienne.
• Mettre en œuvre et faire appliquer des contrôles de la qualité des données, des règles de validation et une surveillance pour assurer la fiabilité des données à l'échelle dans un environnement opérationnel.
• Fournir des ensembles de données prêts à l'analyse (schémas propres, sémantique cohérente, données chronologiques) à BI en aval, des niveaux d'analyse et de modélisation avancés qui appuient la prise de décisions opérationnelles.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de MSAT, de développement de processus, d'automatisation, d'AQ, d'informatique et de données mondiales pour harmoniser les modèles de données, les définitions et les modèles d'intégration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Améliorer continuellement le rendement, la robustesse et la viabilité des pipelines conformément aux priorités opérationnelles. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous pensez dans les pipelines, les schémas et les modes d'échec, pas les fichiers et les solutions manuelles.
• Vous concevez la répétabilité, l'observabilité et l'échelle dans des environnements où la fiabilité compte.
• Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler sur les systèmes OT, MES et plateformes de données en nuage.
• Vous prenez la propriété de bout en bout, des systèmes source aux consommateurs d'analyse.
• Vous simplifiez les paysages de données opérationnelles complexes sans perdre de détails de processus critiques. Ce que vous apportez:
• Expérience pratique de construction et d'exploitation de pipelines de données de production dans des environnements opérationnels ou industriels.
• Forte expertise SQL et expérience optimiser les requêtes pour les charges de travail opérationnelles.
• Expérience éprouvée avec les données de traitement et d'exécution des pipelines ETL/ELT.
• Exposition directe aux historiens (PI), aux MES, aux données d'instruments ou aux systèmes d'OT similaires.
• Compréhension solide de la qualité des données, de la lignée, de la traçabilité et de la gouvernance idéalement dans les environnements réglementés (GxP).
• Expérience avec les plates-formes de données en nuage, de préférence Azure, y compris la construction et la gestion de pipelines de données (Azure Data Factory), les solutions de stockage de données (Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage) et le contrôle de version avec Git.
• Le contexte des données biopharmaceutiques, de fabrication ou d'exploitation est fortement privilégié.
• Études : Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'informatique, d'informatique ou d'un domaine technique connexe préféré – une expérience opérationnelle équivalente sera envisagée. Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence importante. Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'âge, au statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è in Stein, AG, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Gioca un ruolo chiave nel mantenere la produzione sterile in esecuzione in modo sicuro e senza intoppi, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di produzione per individuare i problemi in anticipo e trasformarli in miglioramenti. Questo è un ruolo pratico con un impatto reale, offrendo visibilità sul piano del negozio, una forte collaborazione tra team, e la possibilità di plasmare una cultura di qualità positiva e proattiva. Al fine di essere vicino al processo si lavorerà in un ambiente di cleanroom più volte alla settimana (preferibilmente ogni giorno. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza! Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni. Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura può essere trovata di seguito.
• Vantaggi in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk Cosa farai:
• Stabilire e mantenere la supervisione di qualità per DPS Manufacturing, con una forte attenzione alla produzione asettica/sterile, monitoraggio ambientale, simulazioni di processo (APS), ispezione visiva e qualificazione del personale. Agire come consulente di qualità e partner commerciale per la produzione e gli stakeholder interni su GMP e temi di conformità.
• Assicurare un'efficace implementazione e proprietà del Sistema Qualità GMP in Sterile Production Stein, tra cui la proprietà SOP e le attività di supervisione della qualità.
• Verificare e approvare protocolli di qualità, relazioni e tendenze EM, tra cui APS, pulizia e detenere studi di tempo, e attrezzature / qualifiche di camera.
• supervisionare i flussi di materiale e di personale conformi a GMP all'interno di operazioni di produzione sterili.
• Guidare ed eseguire attività di conformità GMP, tra cui controllo di cambiamento, deviazioni, gestione dei documenti, tra gli altri. Sostegno e piombo progetti legati alla qualità, iniziative di miglioramento continuo e sviluppo di strumenti e processi QA.
• Rappresentare il QA durante le ispezioni, gli audit e le auto-ispezione, nonché nelle iniziative di qualità locali e globali.
• Servire come primo contatto QA per problemi di conformità della produzione sterile Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Esperienza solida nell'ambiente controllato GMP nell'assicurazione qualità o nella produzione aseptica
• Hai una solida esperienza nella gestione delle deviazioni, certificata idealmente per la gestione delle deviazioni
• L'esperienza nella supervisione della produzione QA è preferita

Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Stein, AG, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin. Dirigez et inspirez une équipe de gestion des matériaux et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'AQ, assurant la conformité aux BPF, la qualité des fournisseurs et la gestion transparente du cycle de vie des matériaux, de l'approvisionnement à la libération. Apportez votre expertise en leadership et de solides compétences en gestion des intervenants pour stimuler l'excellence en qualité, l'amélioration continue et la collaboration interfonctionnelle dans un environnement pharmaceutique dynamique. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza! C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées. Ce que vous obtiendrez :
• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.
• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé. En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices Ce que vous ferez :
• Diriger, développer et gérer l'équipe de gestion du matériel et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'AQ à différents niveaux d'ancienneté, en assurant le rendement, la capacité et la conformité.
• Assurer la conformité aux BPF tout au long du cycle de vie des matières premières et des matériaux d'emballage primaires, de l'approvisionnement aux rejets.
• Assurer la surveillance de l'AQ des pratiques de rejet et d'entreposage des matières premières. Assurer la gouvernance de l'AQ des processus d'entreposage et de logistique, y compris la réception des marchandises, la circulation des matières et l'intégrité des données maîtresses. Superviser la gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs, y compris la qualification des fournisseurs, les accords de qualité, la surveillance du rendement et l'intégrité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
• Superviser l'introduction et la gestion du cycle de vie des nouveaux matériaux et fournisseurs, en assurant la conformité aux BPF et l'alignement interfonctionnel. Examiner et approuver la documentation essentielle sur l'AQ, y compris les spécifications, les SOP, les documents de validation, les écarts et les modifications, le cas échéant.
• Agir en tant que point d'escalade et pouvoir de décision pour les questions complexes de qualité liées aux matériaux, aux fournisseurs et à la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
• Appuyer les vérifications et les inspections, en veillant à ce que la gestion des fournisseurs locaux, les processus matériels et la logistique soient prêts.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue, la gestion de l'ICP et la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre l'AQ, le QC, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la fabrication Ce que nous cherchons:
• Vous êtes un chef de file expérimenté et vous insistez sur l'écoute et l'encadrement de votre équipe.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans l'établissement de relations solides – aussi avec des intervenants ou des groupes d'intervenants difficiles
• Expérience approfondie en matière d'AQ dans l'environnement pharmaceutique des BPF, en mettant l'accent sur la gestion des matériaux et la chaîne d'approvisionnement (logement et gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs)
• Diplôme universitaire en sciences pharmaceutiques, chimie, biochimie ou domaine connexe
• Vous êtes heureux de passer 3 jours sur notre site à Stein et 2 jours sur notre site à Bâle (ou vice versa) par semaine
• Une maîtrise de l'anglais et au moins un niveau intermédiaire allemand sont requis À propos de Lonza À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Anlagen- und Apparatebauer Rohrbau EFZ.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau

• Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen

• Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern,  bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen

• Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join our growing sterile Fill & Finish operations as an Operator and contribute to high‑quality manufacturing in a dynamic, expanding environment. Become part of an international team. We are currently working in day time (no shift), however around 2027/2028 a 2-shift model (early/late) will be introduced. Check out Your Career in Drug Product Services at Lonza What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk What you will do:
• Participation in qualification and validation of pharmaceutical production lines and processes (fill&finish lines) in a cleanroom
• Adherence to the relevant SOPs, EHS and GMP regulations
• Independent operation of the assigned parts of the fill&finish equipment and devices, including their pre‑ and post‑processing
• Execution of microbiological environmental monitoring, in‑process controls and sampling
• Identification and reporting of potential issues, as well as active support in continuous improvement processes
• Timely and GMP‑compliant documentation of all activities (e.g. in computer systems such as MES or in logbooks)
• Inspection of equipment, ensuring that it is cleaned and correctly stored What we are looking for:
• Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing within a GMP‑controlled, cleanroom environment is essential
• Exposure to aseptic Fill & Finish (vials or syringes) is a plus
• Completed vocational training in the pharmaceutical field is considered an advantage
• A detail‑oriented mindset, with GMP‑compliant work as a natural standard; you enjoy collaborating in a team and thrive in a dynamic environment
• Fluency in German as well as good skills in English are a prerequisite
• Willingness to work daytime initially and transition to a two‑shift model around 2027/2028
• Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment, including full gowning procedures About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we develop production-ready analytics and models that help teams understand process behavior, improve performance, and make better decisions. Our role is to transform operational data into actionable insight, used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global teams to monitor processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support robust decision-making. We are looking for a Data Scientist - Process Analytics & Data Intelligence Expert to design, build, and deploy advanced analytics that directly support operational excellence. What You Will Do
• Develop and maintain advanced analytics models for operations, including multivariate data analysis (MVDA), statistical models, and predictive approaches.
• Build operational dashboards and analytical views that clearly communicate process performance, variability and risk.
• Analyze process trends, bottlenecks, and performance drivers across units, batches, and campaigns.
• Apply statistical and data science techniques to identify root causes, patterns, and improvement opportunities.
• Translate analytical insights into clear, actionable recommendations that can be applied by MSAT, Process Development, and Operations teams.
• Work closely with data engineering, MSAT, Process Development, and global data teams to ensure analytics are built on consistent, trusted, and well-contextualized data.
• Continuously improve analytics products based on operational feedback and evolving needs. Who You Are
• You think in terms of process behavior, variability, and cause–effect relationships, not just models.
• You are comfortable moving between data, process understanding, and operational decision-making.
• You communicate complex analyses clearly and focus on what drives action.
• You take ownership from analysis to recommendation, not stopping at insight alone.
• You are comfortable working in operational and regulated environments. What You Bring
• Experience in data science, advanced analytics, or process analytics applied to operational data.
• Strong hands-on expertise in MVDA, statistical analysis, trend analysis, and predictive modeling.
• Practical experience using tools such as SIMCA, Seeq, Statistica, and Python (or equivalent analytics environments).
• Experience building dashboards and analytical tools used in day-to-day operations.
• Ability to work with time-series and contextualized process data.
• Solid understanding of process development, manufacturing, or operational workflows.
• Experience in biopharma, manufacturing, or other regulated environments is strongly preferred.
• Education: Degree in Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field preferred — equivalent operational analytics experience will be considered. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

In this role, you will be at the center of data-driven decision-making, ensuring accurate data extraction, transformation, and reporting to enable technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. You will also play a key role in safeguarding data integrity, evaluating process performance, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across our manufacturing operations. Your work will directly contribute to robust processes and successful product delivery. If you are passionate about data, enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment, and want to make a tangible impact in biologics manufacturing, this is your opportunity. Apply now and be part of our success story in Visp. This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits What you will do:
• Extract, structure, and curate manufacturing and batch record data (paper and electronic) to support data-driven decisions
• Prepare and analyze process data for investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and continuous improvement initiatives
• Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI) for process monitoring
• Support Continuous Process Verification (CPV) and generate control charts and product quality reports
• Perform statistical analysis (e.g., trending, capability studies) to evaluate process performance and identify improvement opportunities
• Collaborate cross-functionally with MSAT, QA, Operations, and Automation to ensure data accuracy and availability
• Contribute to SOPs, technical reports, and regulatory documentation while ensuring GMP/GDP compliance What we are looking for:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
• Initial experience (1–3 years) in biopharma manufacturing, data analytics, or a regulated environment
• Strong data handling and analysis skills, including advanced Excel capabilities; Power BI or VBA is a plus
• Knowledge of statistical methods and tools (e.g., Minitab, JMP, Python, R, SeeQ, or similar)
• Experience working with manufacturing data sources such as batch records, DeltaV, or electronic systems is advantageous

As a part of the Global Master Data team, you will be able to learn SAP Materials Management (MM), Production & Planning (PP) and Sales & Distribution (SD) modules, key business processes as well as SAP data structures. Location. Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung. Am Standort Visp wird im Bereich Pharma (Advanced Synthesis) ein/e erfahrene/r Laborant/in (m/w/d) mit Feststoffexpertise gesucht. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Feststoffbereich zuständig. Im Weiteren sind Sie für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des Feststofflabors zuständig und stehen Kollegen bei Experimenten beratend zur Seite. Zusammen mit Sachbearbeitern vertreten Sie den Feststoffbereich in Projektteams im Bereich Entwicklung, Optimierung und Troubleshooting. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen. Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:
• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Ihre Aufgaben:
• Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Bereich Kristallisation, Filtration, Trocknung, Mahlen, Sieben und Feststoffcharakterisierung
• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung vom Feststofflabor sowie Unterhalt der Geräte
• Fachtechnische Laborverantwortung und Ansprechpartner für feststoffspezifische Fragestellung bei Laborexperimenten
• Aus- und Weiterbildung von Lehrlingen & Praktikanten
• Mitarbeit in Projekten bei feststoffspezifischen Fragestellungen und Unterstützung der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsgruppen, sowie der Produktionsbetriebe Was wir suchen:
• Laborant EFZ (Chemie) oder vergleichbar
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Feststoffbereich
• Fliessend Deutsch ist notwendig, zusätzliche Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Teamfähigkeit
• Freude an der interdisziplinären Arbeit
• Vernetztes Denken
• Kreatives, lösungsorientiertes Handeln Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben! Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. The QA Specialist (QA On The Floor) is responsible to the Associate Director, Head of QA Operations BioAtrium in joining a strong and innovative team that is perceived as a main contributor to the success of the large scale mammalian operations in our future BioAtrium site. A great candidate will have strong GMP mindset, have leadership capabilities, envisioning and driving teamwork, quality culture, and innovation with the goal of becoming a role model within Lonza. We are looking for someone comfortable working in a matrix organization, effective with cross-functional projects, someone who can conceptualize where we need to be, how to get there, and drive ideas to completion. The QA Specialist will within the QA Operations team as QA On The Floor, but will support other QA Ops teams (e.g. Clean Utilities and Environmental Monitoring, QA for QC and Electronic Batch Record Review) They will interact with the the other Operational teams at BioAtrium like Production, Engineering and Project Management. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Comply with, Develop, implement and monitor quality procedures to ensure compliance with GxP standards, corporate policies, Swissmedic, FDA and other regulatory body regulations and guidelines.
• Support all QA operations activities concerning SOP landscape, electronic batch records, training, deviation- / CAPA- and change control management
• Support all audits and inspections
• Identify and implement Lean / OPEX approaches in Quality and foster improvement projects
• Provide KPI reporting and execute action plans to address opportunities for improvement
• Work collaboratively with QA Operations and QA department colleagues What we are looking for:
• Academic degree in a Life Science discipline/ Engineering/ Quality Management or related field
• Experience in working on a regulated Medical device, Drug product or Drug Substance site
• Experience with Lean / Operational Excellence / Six Sigma
• GMP compliance expertise
• Ability to interface and communicate directly with customers and regulatory bodies
• Excellent written and oral communication to include accurate and legible documentation
• Ability to work on call and/or out of normal working hours on site
• Fluency in English is required, German language skills are an advantage About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il People Insights & Analytics Intern svolge un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare la capacità di consegna del team attraverso intuizioni HR prioritarie, iniziative di creazione di capacità e attività di miglioramento operativo. Questa posizione garantisce continuità, struttura e un'efficace esecuzione nel team HR Insights. Sosterrai il coordinamento, la preparazione e il follow-through delle priorità del team attraverso la comunicazione, lo sviluppo dei contenuti, la documentazione di processo e il supporto del flusso di lavoro. Operando attraverso la consegna del team, l'abilitazione dell'apprendimento e l'ottimizzazione dei processi, vi aiuterà a tradurre le priorità strategiche in modi strutturati, scalabili ed efficienti di lavoro. Cosa otterrai:

• Mentorialità e opportunità di sviluppo professionale. Cosa farai:
• Sostenere la consegna di informazioni HR prioritarie, attività di abilitazione e miglioramento operativo in tutto il team
• Coordinare le attività quotidiane, le comunicazioni, i materiali e il follow-through per sostenere l'effettiva esecuzione delle priorità
• Preparare e mantenere la documentazione, le presentazioni, i tracker e i contenuti di riferimento per supportare la consegna e la continuità
• Contribuire ai miglioramenti del processo e allo sviluppo di metodi pratici, scalabili e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale
• Supportare l'apprendimento, l'adozione e le attività di abilitazione che aiutano le parti interessate a lavorare in modo più efficace con dati, contenuti e processi Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Corso di laurea (o attualmente iscritto) in Risorse Umane, Economia o un campo relativo
• Forte competenza negli strumenti Office 365, in particolare PowerPoint, buona competenza in Excel
• Eccellente capacità organizzativa e di coordinamento, con la capacità di gestire più attività in un ambiente frenetico
• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale
• pensiero analitico, capacità di problem solving, e attenzione ai dettagli
• Interessi in dati HR, reporting, approfondimenti e miglioramento dei processi
• Hands-on interesse nell'utilizzo di strumenti Generativi AI in modo pratico e responsabile
• Stile di lavoro collaborativo e orientato al servizio

Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. As Team Lead Visual Inspection, you are primarily responsible for the personnel management and development of your employees. You are also responsible for the daily tasks in the production. Due to the special interface function between management and production, this position is fundamentally important for the long-term success of Lonza. There are also regular exchange meetings with other team leaders in order to optimize efficiency together. You are responsible for training and coaching your employees, conducting performance reviews and actively supporting their further development. You are part of the management team and use your experience to actively help set up the team and the system. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. What you will do:
• Leading, coaching and developing employees
• Setting priorities and allocating resources to meet deadlines
• Participating in investigations of deviations and improvement projects
• Ensuring safety and GMP compliance
• Recognizing, interpreting and eliminating deviations
• Participating in audits and visits
• Executes Visual Inspection in the area of Drug Product according to cGMP guidelines
• Provides technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing team in a supportive way
• Performs training activities of Visual Inspection and supports others and new joiners. What we are looking for:
• Past experience as a shift team leader in production is requested
• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education (CPT) or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related disciplines is an advantage
• Structured, focused and organized way of working, assertive and motivated, working independently, flexible and resilient
• High attitude for Safety, Quality, Solution focus and Cooperation
• Knowledge of Visual Inspection's process
• Coordination of resources and workflows
• Fluency in English (written and oral) and German would be an advantage
• Availability to work in 2 shifts model About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
