descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

In this senior leadership role, you will lead an interdisciplinary Analytical Development team responsible for the implementation, development,  optimization, and validation of analytical methods for  small‑molecule products in a GMP‑regulated environment. In addition, the team provides analytical expertise and measurement support to process development and manufacturing teams, advising on analytical techniques, data interpretation, and method selection.
You will ensure that people, capabilities, and assets consistently deliver high‑quality analytical services, particularly chromatography techniques to internal and external customers, in line with agreed timelines, cost targets, and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Provide scientific and disciplinary leadership for a team of approximately

• 30 development scientists, project leaders, and laboratory technicians

• Coordinates and optimizes the allocation of resources (e.g. personnel, equipment, laboratories, etc) to meet project needs and customer expectations.

• Oversee the development, validation, transfer of analytical methods, and support of process development and manufacturing teams with a strong focus on chromatographic techniques

• Ensure full compliance with GMP, quality standards, and safety regulations across all development and production support activities

• Manage project portfolios, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation to meet customer and business objectives

• Act as a technical expert and key interface for internal stakeholders and external customers, including participation in audits and inspections

• Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence in analytical and chemical development processes

What we are looking for:

• PhD or MSc in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmacy, or Chemical Engineering

• More than 10 years of industrial experience in chemical and/or analytical development within a GMP environment

• Strong expertise in chromatographic methods (e.g. HPLC/UPLC, LC‑MS, GC) applied to process understanding and optimization

• You demonstrate creative problem‑solving, active listening, and strong communication skills, enabling effective cross‑functional collaboration and interdisciplinary teamwork.

• Demonstrated leadership experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams in an industrial setting

• Solid understanding of business processes, cost control, and customer‑focused project execution

• Fluency in English; German proficiency or strong willingness to learn German

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
Lonza is a global leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. While we are driven by science, there is no magic formula for how we approach our work. Our most valuable scientific solution is our dedicated people who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies improve lives. In return, our employees manage their careers independently, as their ideas—whether big or small—make the world a better place. This is the kind of work we want to be part of.
A new production plant in the field of biotechnological production is being built at the Visp site. This is an exciting time to join our team, whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career. We’re seeking motivated and resilient individuals to play a key role in vaccine production—both during the project phase and as we transition to routine operations.
Join us as an Operator – Opportunities for All Experience Levels!

What you’ll do:
during the project phase:

• Support the project team in defining and setting up innovative vaccine production processes.

• Collaborate on the qualification and validation of new production areas and processes.

in routine production

• Adhere to relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and regulations (e.g., hygiene concept, safety regulations)

• Independently operate production plants and equipment, including preparation, operation, and post-processing, following SOPs.

• Perform microbiological environmental monitoring, in-process controls (IPC), and sample taking

• Monitor production processes, detect and report potential issues, and actively participate in continuous improvement processes

• Conduct GMP-compliant work and timely documentation of activities (e.g., computer systems (MES) or log books)

• Handle, clean, store, and inspect equipment

What we’re looking for:

• We welcome candidates from all experience levels, whether you’re a seasoned expert or a career changer with relevant qualifications. If you’re enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge vaccine production, we’d love to hear from you

• for Entry-Level Candidates: Completed apprenticeship in pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotechnological fields, or a relevant university degree

• for Experienced Professionals: Several years of experience in pharmaceutical production, particularly in GMP and cleanroom environments, is a plus.

• Safety awareness

• Fluent in German and/or English

• Willingness to work shifts (4 shifts)

• Ability to work in a team, reliability, and a high degree of personal responsibility

• Flexibility

Lonza's products and services positively impact millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor but also a significant responsibility. How we achieve our business results is as important to us as the results themselves. At Lonza, respect is paramount, and we protect both our employees and our environment. For us, success means morally justifiable progress.
Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges.
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging (IDB)
Inclusion is one of Lonza’s four core values, alongside integrity, innovation and initiative. We understand the value of our differences and the benefits they bring to our company, community and culture. We also recognize the value of every person’s contribution, regardless of characteristics, preferences and beliefs – including race, color, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity and religion.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

A new production plant in the field of biotechnological production is being built at the Visp site. This is an exciting time to join our team, whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career. We’re seeking motivated and resilient individuals to play a key role in vaccine production—both during the project phase and as we transition to routine operations.
Join us as an Operator – Opportunities for All Experience Levels!

What you’ll do:
during the project phase:

• Support the project team in defining and setting up innovative vaccine production processes.

• Collaborate on the qualification and validation of new production areas and processes.

in routine production

• Adhere to relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and regulations (e.g., hygiene concept, safety regulations)

• Independently operate production plants and equipment, including preparation, operation, and post-processing, following SOPs.

• Perform microbiological environmental monitoring, in-process controls (IPC), and sample taking

• Monitor production processes, detect and report potential issues, and actively participate in continuous improvement processes

• Conduct GMP-compliant work and timely documentation of activities (e.g., computer systems (MES) or log books)

• Handle, clean, store, and inspect equipment

What we’re looking for:

• We welcome candidates from all experience levels, whether you’re a seasoned expert or a career changer with relevant qualifications. If you’re enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge vaccine production, we’d love to hear from you

• for Entry-Level Candidates: Completed apprenticeship in pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotechnological fields, or a relevant university degree

• for Experienced Professionals: Several years of experience in pharmaceutical production, particularly in GMP and cleanroom environments, is a plus.

• Safety awareness

• Fluent in German and/or English

• Willingness to work shifts (4 shifts)

• Ability to work in a team, reliability, and a high degree of personal responsibility

• Flexibility

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As Team Lead Visual Inspection, you are primarily responsible for the personnel management and development of your employees. You are also responsible for the daily tasks in the production. Due to the special interface function between management and production, this position is fundamentally important for the long-term success of Lonza. There are also regular exchange meetings with other team leaders in order to optimize efficiency together. You are responsible for training and coaching your employees, conducting performance reviews and actively supporting their further development. You are part of the management team and use your experience to actively help set up the team and the system.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Leading, coaching and developing employees

• Setting priorities and allocating resources to meet deadlines

• Participating in investigations of deviations and improvement projects

• Ensuring safety and GMP compliance

• Recognizing, interpreting and eliminating deviations

• Participating in audits and visits

• Executes Visual Inspection in the area of Drug Product according to cGMP guidelines

• Provides technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing team in a supportive way

• Performs training activities of Visual Inspection and supports others and new joiners.

What we are looking for:

• Past experience as a shift team leader in production is requested

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education (CPT) or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related disciplines is an advantage

• Structured, focused and organized way of working, assertive and motivated, working independently, flexible and resilient

• High attitude for Safety, Quality, Solution focus and Cooperation

• Knowledge of Visual Inspection's process

• Coordination of resources and workflows

• Fluency in English (written and oral) and German would be an advantage

• Availability to work in 2 shifts model

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

title: Internship MSAT Material Management / MSAT Process Expert

titleByLocale.en: Internship MSAT Material Management / MSAT Process Expert
titleByLocale.it: Internship MSAT Material Management / MSAT Process Expert
titleByLocale.de: Internship MSAT Material Management / MSAT Process Expert
titleByLocale.fr: Internship MSAT Material Management / MSAT Process Expert

descriptionByLocale.en:
MSAT Microbial provides end-to-end technical expertise across the microbial manufacturing lifecycle, acting as the key link between process knowledge, manufacturing execution and product quality.
The team serves as process experts for microbial upstream and downstream processes, supporting process understanding, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement during clinical and commercial manufacturing. In parallel, the MSAT expert is providing support to project teams in regard to initial raw material selection, design and qualification of single use assemblies, support during material quality issues and shortages. Through close collaboration with Manufacturing, Quality and other cross-functional partners, MSAT Microbial ensures robust, compliant and scalable processes, supporting safe, reliable and efficient drug substance supply.

As an Intern as MSAT material management / MSAT Process Expert, you will gain hands-on insights into the core MSAT material management and process-related activities supporting microbial manufacturing operations.

What you’ll get:

• ​A dynamic, agile career path with room to grow

• An inclusive, ethical, and supportive workplace culture

• A comprehensive benefits package tailored to your role and location

What you will do:

• Support activities related to material management in microbial cGMP manufacturing processes

• Support mitigation actions in material quality issues

• Support design and qualification of single use assemblies

• Coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders (MSAT, QA, QC, Production, Supply Chain) during document preparation and review

• Monitor progress of activities and identify potential delays or roadblocks

• Escalate issues and risks in a timely manner to the responsible MSAT process expert lead

• Support data review, trending and analysis activities related to material management

• Support MSAT Process Expert core activities in the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning over coordination, implementation, control and project completion aligned with project management goals

• Support the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory requirements

• Support the execution of GMP risk analysis for the manufacturing processes

• Support timely compilation of process related deviations and change requests (related to material management and cGMP manufacturing processes)

• Support continuous improvement projects

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Chemistry, Chemical, Biochemical Engineering, Pharmacy or a related scientific or technical discipline

• Strong interest in microbial manufacturing processes and process lifecycle management

• Basic understanding of bioprocess fundamentals, such as: microbial upstream and/or downstream processes and process parameters and their impact on product quality

• High attention to detail and interest in technical documentation and data integrity

• Strong interest in GMP environments and regulated manufacturing

• Good organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, interacting with Manufacturing, Quality and Quality Control

• Structured, analytical mindset with problem-solving orientation

• Good knowledge of English, both written and spoken

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/e Brandschutzfachmann/frau / experte/in gesucht. In dieser Position werden Sie als selbstständige/r Fachperson für die Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller Brandschutzgesetze und Richtlinien auf dem Werksareal verantwortlich sein. Sie stellen die Koordination der verschiedenen Fachbereiche und Anspruchsgruppen (z.B. Projektleiter, Betriebsleiter) im Rahmen der Gesetzgebung sicher. Sie beraten Projektteams und führen nach Verfügbarkeit selbstständig QS Brandschutz Projekte durch. Sie definieren anhand der Vorgaben, den organisatorischen BS und weisen die Verantwortlichen Betreiber auf die Umsetzung hin. Durch sporadische interne Audits, überprüfen Sie die Umsetzung durch die Betreiber.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung des Brandschutzes

• Sicherstellung der Koordination aller internen und externen Fachbereiche Brandschutz (Behörden, Ereignisdienste, Fachplaner, Engeneering usw.) untereinander

• Sicherstellung der Werksinternen Brandschutzmassnahmen im Rahmen der Businesskontinuität, der Vorgaben von Versicherern, Vorgaben aus technischen Richtlinien (inkl. TRCI)

• Beratung von Projektteams, Bauherrschaften, Brandschutz- und Fachplanern im Rahmen der Planung, Ausführung, Abnahme, Sicherstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft und der Wartungen

• Führt selbstständig BS Audits durch und definiert Massnahmen für die Betreiber

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Brandschutzexperte/in VKF oder gleichwertige Ausbildung oder Brandschutzfachmann/frau mit dem Nachweis mehrerer QS BS Projekte QSS 2

• Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der chemische oder biologische Produktion Industrie von Vorteil

• Ausgezeichnete mündliche, schriftliche und zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten (Priorisierung in schnelllebiger Umgebung) sowie eine selbstständige und präzise Arbeitsweise

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden und Ämtern wünschenswert

• Deutsch (Muttersprache), Englisch (verhandlungssicher) von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

In this role you will have the opportunity to lead the visual inspection and container closure integrity testing team at the heart of Drug Product Services. With full technical ownership across automated, semi‑automated, and manual visual inspection processes, you will partner closely with customers, health authorities, and cross‑functional teams to deliver safe, compliant, and high‑quality outcomes. You will lead and develop a fast‑growing expert team, driving innovation and successfully scaling next‑generation inspection technologies as part of an exciting growth project.
Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza !

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• A highly collaborative environment that fosters teamwork and inclusion.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Manage a team of a Vision Engineers, Process Experts and Operators with responsibility for all aspects of people leadership such as development, coaching, hiring and disciplinary topics. Maintain a culture of empowerment and innovation, trust, high performance and change readiness.

• Technical system ownership: Provide scientific leadership to the team and other functions to ensure visual inspection processes are executed timely, cost effective and with the highest quality. Proactively anticipate, evaluate and resolve technical challenges and enables innovation.

• Responsible for operative takeover of the automated, semi-automated,  manual visual inspection and  container closure integrity testing

• Manage the customer interface in technical client visits and adapt technical capabilities in order to meet the customer requirements. Represent the facility during regulatory inspections and audits of clients and health authorities.

• Accountable for safety, compliance and regulatory aspects. Preparation of risk analysis and all relevant procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and achieve business goals.

• Support of the project team regarding complex topics by use of scientific and statistical knowledge.

• Ensure and manage the interfaces between CAPEX team, Manufacturing, Plant Engineering, Automation, Support, QC and QA. Collaborate with functions in the project and across Drug Product Services, especially the existing drug product facilities)

• Support the Senior Director Operational Lead of one of our largest growth project (Dolphin) in developing, prioritizing and achieving goals with respect to the project and overall DPS (Drug Product Services) goals. Ensure a good information exchange from the management level to the organization and the other way around through regularly team meetings and clear communication.

What we are looking for:

• Extensive experience in visual inspection of parenteral drug product (specifically vials and syringes) in a GMP environment is a must. Broad experience with various different visual inspection systems such as manual, semi-automatic or AVI is an advantage.

• Team leadership experience is a prerequisite

• Experience with audits of health authorities

• Fluency in English is a must (fluency in German is an advantage) with strong communication skills with stakeholders from various functions and levels.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Für Drug Product Services (DPS), unsere erfolgreiche Niederlassung innerhalb einer internationalen Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), bieten wir dir am Standort Stein eine spannende und verantwortungsvolle Position.
Werde Teil eines engagierten Automation-Teams und trage aktiv dazu bei, unsere Kund:innen bei der Bewältigung zentraler Herausforderungen in der modernen Patientenversorgung zu unterstützen.

Als Automatiker/Automation Technician bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und Engineering. Du verantwortest sämtliche Automationsaufgaben im Rahmen der reaktiven, proaktiven und präventiven Instandhaltung und leistest damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Anlagenverfügbarkeit, Qualität und Compliance am Standort Stein.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du übernimmst den First Level Support sowie das Troubleshooting an Produktions- und Infrastrukturanlagen

• Du überwachst und kontrollierst automatisierte Produktionsprozesse und stellst deren stabilen Betrieb sicher

• Du unterstützt die Produktion schnell und lösungsorientiert bei Störungen und GxP-relevanten Fragestellungen

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Mechanikern zusammen und unterstützt sie bei der Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung

• Du bewirtschaftest Ersatzteile im Bereich MSR/E und koordinierst deren Beschaffung

• Du wirkst in der reaktiven, proaktiven und präventiven Instandhaltung im Automationsumfeld mit

• Du setzt die bestehende Instandhaltungsstrategie um und entwickelst sie unter Berücksichtigung von Verfügbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit weiter

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Automatiker, Mechatroniker oder vergleichbar)

• Du bringst solide Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung mit, idealerweise im Pharma- oder GMP-Umfeld

• Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der Anlagenprogrammierung (zum Beispiel: Siemens Step7, TIA Portal, Emerson DeltaV oder BMS)

• Ein Berufsbildner-Ausweis sowie die Betriebselektrikerbewilligung nach NIV13 sind von Vorteil

• Du bist bereit, Pikettdienste zu übernehmen

• Du zeichnest dich durch Teamfähigkeit, Serviceorientierung und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?
Jetzt bewerben

Für Drug Product Services (DPS), unsere erfolgreiche Niederlassung innerhalb einer internationalen Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), bieten wir dir am Standort Stein eine spannende und verantwortungsvolle Position.
Werde Teil eines engagierten Automation-Teams und trage aktiv dazu bei, unsere Kund:innen bei der Bewältigung zentraler Herausforderungen in der modernen Patientenversorgung zu unterstützen.

Als Automatiker/Automation Technician bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und Engineering. Du verantwortest sämtliche Automationsaufgaben im Rahmen der reaktiven, proaktiven und präventiven Instandhaltung und leistest damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Anlagenverfügbarkeit, Qualität und Compliance am Standort Stein.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du übernimmst den First Level Support sowie das Troubleshooting an Produktions- und Infrastrukturanlagen

• Du überwachst und kontrollierst automatisierte Produktionsprozesse und stellst deren stabilen Betrieb sicher

• Du unterstützt die Produktion schnell und lösungsorientiert bei Störungen und GxP-relevanten Fragestellungen

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Mechanikern zusammen und unterstützt sie bei der Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung

• Du bewirtschaftest Ersatzteile im Bereich MSR/E und koordinierst deren Beschaffung

• Du wirkst in der reaktiven, proaktiven und präventiven Instandhaltung im Automationsumfeld mit

• Du setzt die bestehende Instandhaltungsstrategie um und entwickelst sie unter Berücksichtigung von Verfügbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit weiter

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Automatiker, Mechatroniker oder vergleichbar)

• Du bringst solide Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung mit, idealerweise im Pharma- oder GMP-Umfeld

• Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der Anlagenprogrammierung (zum Beispiel: Siemens Step7, TIA Portal, Emerson DeltaV oder BMS)

• Ein Berufsbildner-Ausweis sowie die Betriebselektrikerbewilligung nach NIV13 sind von Vorteil

• Du bist bereit, Pikettdienste zu übernehmen

• Du zeichnest dich durch Teamfähigkeit, Serviceorientierung und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?
Jetzt bewerben

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Integrated Biologics organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timelines, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.

• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Apollo befindet sich derzeit in der spannenden Start-up Phase, was Ihnen die Möglichkeit bietet, nicht nur Teil eines vielversprechenden Projekts zu sein, sondern auch ein umfassendes Fachwissen aufzubauen.

• Eigenverantwortliches Bedienen der Ihnen zugewiesenen Teile der Produktionsanlage gemäss Vorgabedokumenten

• Gewährleistung einer sicheren und korrekten Ausführung der Arbeit unter Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen

• Übernahme der Verantwortung für Sauberkeit und Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie in den zugewiesenen Räumen und Lagern

• Teamorientierung und die Fähigkeit, effektiv im Team zu arbeiten

titleByLocale.it: Associate Direttore, Asset Design and Innovation 80-100% (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Associate Directeur, Asset Design and Innovation 80-100% (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp , Switzerland, this role operates at the interface of Operations, Engineering and Strategic Growth Projects within the Advanced Synthesis network. In close collaboration with Global Engineering, MSAT, Quality and Strategy teams, the Associate Director, Asset Design and Innovation leads the development, evaluation and implementation of state-of-the-art and future-oriented asset and technology solutions with focus on growth-projects. This role is ideal for a self‑driven individual who proactively identifies opportunities to improve asset design, manufacturing performance and technology deployment. The position has a strong focus on enabling highly cost‑effective, compliant and reliable manufacturing by design, with particular emphasis on optimized lifecycle and OpEx performance. Beyond individual projects, the role actively shapes a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and innovation across the global network and may take key responsibilities in selected global strategic growth initiatives.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Proactively identify, evaluate and drive opportunities to improve asset design and manufacturing technologies, delivering measurable gains in cost, reliability and performance.

• Take full end-to-end ownership for innovation initiatives in growth projects – from idea generation and feasibility assessment through business case development, implementation oversight and benefit realization.

• Independently evaluate, propose and justify solutions that optimize operational expenditure (OpEx) and asset lifecycle costs by design.

• Actively integrate forward-looking, fit-for-purpose solutions into strategic growth projects while ensuring full cGMP compliance and adherence to safety standards.

• Continuously challenge the status quo, share best practices and actively contribute to building a sustainable manufacturing innovation platform across the Advanced Synthesis network.

• Support and constructively challenge by proactively contributing ideas, insights and execution power to strategic transformation initiatives.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biologics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Senior-level, self-driven leader with a proven track record of identifying opportunities and converting them into sustainable operational and business impact.

• Demonstrated ability to independently set direction, take full ownership and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion in a global matrix environment.

• Deep manufacturing, engineering and technology expertise, combined with the confidence to challenge the status quo and influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to build, defend and execute robust business cases while delivering against demanding performance targets.

• Acts as a role model for accountability, execution excellence and continuous improvement, leading through actions rather than formal authority.

• Innovative mindset with the ability to think beyond traditional boundaries; experience with Lonza systems and processes is a plus.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, enabling alignment and momentum across functions and leadership levels.

• Fluent in English; German proficiency is a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

Location, Visp, Switzerland.

Starte deine Karriere als Praktikant/in im Trainingsteam  der LP/SSP - Small Molecules (m/w/d) in der pharmazeutischen Industrie – unterstütze unser Team für 6-12 Monate in Visp beim Aufarbeiten und der Optimierung von Schulungsmaterialien. Spannende und detailreiche Einblicke in den chemischen Betrieb, moderne Technologien und echte Verantwortung warten auf dich!

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Beschaffen und Bearbeiten von schulungsrelevanten Informationen und Hilfsmitteln in Bezug auf betriebliche Prozesse.

• Selbstständige Ausarbeitung von Schulungsunterlagen und Arbeitsanweisungen für den Betrieb.

• Aktualisieren und Überprüfen von Schulungsdokumenten.

• Mitarbeit an der Umsetzung des Trainingskonzepts für Operatoren und der Dokumentation von Trainingserfolgen.

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene chemische oder pharmatechnologische Berufsausbildung. (Eidgenössisches Fachzeugnis EFZ). Von Vorteil: Bachelor-Abschluss (Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen), Fachhochschulstudium (FH)/ Technikerschule (HF) oder ähnliches.

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten, ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

• Strukturiertes, fokussiertes und sehr gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten.

• Interesse an chemischen Produktionsprozessen.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Hybrid Work Model is applicable. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our site in Visp we are currently looking for a Senior Quality Excellence Manager (m/f/d), who will become part of our Quality Excellence team. In this role, you will drive operational excellence at its best and contribute as a strong influential LEAN specialist within a matrix organization to support our Quality organization on its way to best in class performance.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Drive process standardization and efficiency in line with Lonza’s LBMS standards

• Support the implementation of a Lean Batch Release program on site

• Establish Quality Excellence CoE and PMO structures, supporting the standardization, simplification and digitalization of our key quality processes

• Facilitate to embed a LEAN culture of continuous improvement and ideation within Quality

• Monitor and enable reporting of Quality performance KPIs for our site in Visp and initiate necessary activities to enable target achievement by the departments in scope

• Support multi-disciplinary project teams and hold team members accountable to achieve the project goals within given timelines

• Share best practice within the Visp Site as well as with the wider Lonza Pharma network

What we are looking for:

• University Degree in a scientific area OR an absolved apprenticeship in a pharmaceutical environment (e.g. Lab Technician, CPT, etc)

• Profound experience in a GMP regulated environment; preferably within QA/QC

• Experience with Lean / Six Sigma, within a Quality related environment

• Certified Green Belt or higher is required

• PowerBI and/or Minitab knowledge would be an advantage

• Fluent German (written and verbal) and good English language skills are required

• Strong ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a dedicated MES Drug Expert to join our team in Visp, Switzerland. If you're passionate about applying your expertise to optimize drug product manufacturing and truly make a difference, we encourage you to explore this opportunity.

What you will do:

• Author and adapt MES/PCS Recipe based on the Drug Product Processes.

• Responsible for defining the overall concept for MES recipes used in Drug Product Operations Visp to ensure an easy and fast creation as well as adaption.

• Build and maintain relevant GMP documents (IQ, OQ, PQ etc.)

• Provide front line MES support, working with the manufacturing teams (operators), plant engineers and QA operations.

• Provide MES training for all end user.

• Act as Subject Matter Expert during customer audits and visits, maintain MES at inspection readiness level and provides support where needed.

• ​Lead process related investigations and critical deviations and assists in decision making on production issues.

• Lead process changes, CAPAs, and CAPA efficiency checks related to process within required timelines and through GMP systems (e.g. Trackwise, MES, training, etc.)

• ​Implements innovation and improvement projects comprising general manufacturing aspects for the production plant.

What we are looking for:

• Studies in Pharmaceutical Technology/ Chemistry/ Pharmacy.

• Experience in MES recipe authoring, preferably in Emerson Syncade.

• Process knowledge in the area of sterile drug product is advantageous.

• Knowledge of DeltaV is preferable.

• Familiar with working in regulated environment, knowledge of cGMP, 21CRF part 11 and validation requirements.

• Proficient in both German and English is an asset.

• Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution.

• Good interpersonal skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization and on the shopfloor.

• Structured, focused and well-organized working demeanor.

• Motivated and driven; with a problem-solving attitude.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/e Laborant/in der QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. Als Mitglied unseres jungen und dynamischen Mikrobiologie-Teams, bist du unter Einhaltung der GMP- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verantwortliche für die Routine-Durchführung von verschiedenen mikrobiologischen Methoden.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung analytischer Methoden im Aufgabenbereich, Auswertung, Review und Berichten der Ergebnisse.

• Erstellen von Analysenprotokollen, Prüfanweisungen und Kurzberichten.

• Dokumentation aller Labortätigkeiten entsprechend GMP und internen Richtlinien.

• Einhaltung der Qualitäts- (SOP und GMP) und der Sicherheitsvorschriften.

• Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor.

• Methodischer Hauptfokus: Keim Identifizierungen und Endotoxin Messungen.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in, BTA, oder BSC mit Fachrichtung Biologie, Biochemie oder ähnlichem Bereich.

• Fliessend Deutsch und English von Vorteil.

• Hands-on Labor Erfahrung (insbesondere Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Analysetechniken) sind ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP ist ein Plus .

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Anlagemeister – Support Infra gewährleistet durch eine intensive Betreuung seiner ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse (Reinstmedien und HVAC) ein nach GMP - Richtlinien funktionsfähiges Produktionsumfeld. Dabei unterstützt er die Projektteams im PCP / PCPSS, welche für die Herstellung von Bioconjugaten verantwortlich sind.
Die Hauptfunktion beinhaltet die Bedienung sowie die korrekte Instandhaltung der Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection, HeatingVentilation & Air Conditioning Systems HVAC, sowie das Erkennen und Beheben von Störungen der ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellen das die Anlagen für Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection und Heating Ventilation & Air Conditioning Systems (HVAC), sowie alle Energie-Systeme laufend regelkonform den Betrieben PCP und PCPSS zur Verfügung stehen.

• Bearbeitung, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen des Umgebungs- und Wassermonitorings sowie dem Monitoring von Prozessgasen im PCP und PCPSS.

• Erstellung und Pflege der notwendigen SOPs für den zugeteilten Bereich

• Unterstützt Fremdfirmen bei Arbeiten in den Betriebsgebäuden und erteilt Arbeitsbewilligungen in seinem zugeteilten Verantwortungsbereich.

• Stellt sicher, dass alle Kühlgeräte und Kühlräume im PCP und PCPSS laufend und regelkonform zur Verfügung stehen

• Vertretung der zugeteilten Bereiche an Behörden- und Kundenaudits

• die Sicherstellung, dass die ihm zugeteilten Systemen/Apparate kontinuierlich und regelkonform betrieben werden.

• die Gewährleistung von funktionsfähigen Systeme/Apparate für die Produktion durch regelmässige Kontrollen und Wartungen.

• die anlagentechnische Schulung/Ausbildung der Operatoren in seinem Aufgabenbereich.

• Sorgt für Sauberkeit und Ordnung in der Anlage und Utilitybereich

• die Unterstützung des AM Supports im Bereich Betriebshygiene PCP

descriptionByLocale.de:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of upstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Join our brand new Fill‑Finish facility in Stein as an Operator Visual Inspection, performing manual inspections today while supporting the transition to semi‑ and fully automated processes. This includes qualification runs and routine inspections in a controlled darkroom setting. We’re looking for a motivated and resilient individual who thrives in structured environments, follows GMP guidelines, and contributes to both the project phase and routine production excellence. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

What you will do:

• Manual, semi-automated, and fully automated visual inspection of liquid and lyophilized vials and syringes in a cleanroom setting

• Classification of defects in accordance with regulations

• Regular qualification and requalification using existing test sets

• Inspection of test runs / threshold studies

• Support in deviations and root cause analysis

What we are looking for:

• Strong attention to detail and cleanliness, with an uncompromising approach to quality and safety

• Willing to work in a cleanroom

• Experience in a GMP production environment is highly desirable

• Experience in visual inspection, including relevant further training is a plus

• Completed vocational training (e.g. as a chemical or pharmaceutical technologist) is an advantage

• Fluency in German is a must and basic knowledge of English

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

You will own defined parts of the site Contamination Control Strategy at one of the largest biologics manufacturing sites in the world, where your decisions shape how a sustained microbial state of control is held shift after shift, batch after batch. You will work alongside colleagues from across the globe, in a site set in the Swiss Alps of the Valais.

What you will get :

• A place in an inclusive, dynamic, and passionate team.

• An unusually broad range of topics and disciplines to accelerate your professional growth and development.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Own defined areas within the site Contamination Control Strategy and hold a sustained microbial state of control across facilities, equipment, processes, and supporting systems.

• Act as the technical lead for contamination control, hygiene, and microbiological QC topics in deviations, change controls, root cause investigations, impact assessments, and CAPAs, including their definition and follow-up.

• Ensure equipment, facility, and process hygienic integrity across the full lifecycle, from design and qualification through start-up, routine use, cleaning and sanitization, maintenance, and bioburden remediation.

• Provide visible shopfloor presence, hands-on technical support, day-to-day guidance, and leadership on contamination control, hygiene, and microbiological QC topics, including GEMBAs, oversight of microbiological methods and testing, and alignment of data trending practices with site contamination control requirements.

• Develop and improve hygiene concepts, gowning expectations, aseptic behavior, microbial hold times, bioburden and endotoxin control strategies, and the associated risk assessments.

• Represent CCS and microbiological quality topics in projects, audits, regulatory inspections, and cross-functional governance forums spanning QA, QC, MSAT, Engineering, Validations, and Operations.

• Drive continuous improvement, KPI delivery, training, and technical guidance commensurate with the risk profile of the site, and stay current with evolving regulatory expectations and industry best practice.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Pharmaceutical Sciences or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Significant experience in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing, with strong exposure to contamination control, microbiological quality, or sterility assurance-related topics.

title: Bioprocess Engineer in USP / DSP / BioConjugates

titleByLocale.en: Bioprocess Engineer in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.it: Bioprocess Ingegnere in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.de: Bioprocess Ingenieur in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.fr: Bioprocess Ingénieur in USP / DSP / BioConjugates

descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

The role is also responsible for operational buying of materials and warehouse/ logistics operations.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• SC Team management including optimal resource's allocation, hiring, gap analysis and talent development

• Flawless coordination of site planning alignment (from demand to execution)

• Ensuring through the warehouse/ logistics team that the movement of material across the site and distribution of products to the customers is conducted

• All medium- and short- term planning processes to ensure fully integrated asset capacity planning, labor planning and material planning (monthly S&OP, weekly operations planning and daily tier process)

• Lead the local monthly S&OP meeting, provide a monthly forecast of all site-based deliverables, supports Finance/Controlling/Program Management financial outlook for the site as agreed at the meeting and submit to Platform Planner

• Robust sourcing information operational buying activities

• Oversee Inventory Management and Materials Flows

• Accountable for Planning and Material Master Data and as well SAP Blueprint implementation, execution and certification

What we are looking for:

• Degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences with solid knowledge in APICS CPIM professional standards

• Over 10 years of work experience in
a) Laboratory Planning and execution – in a testing or development lab and
b) Supply Chain / Logistics - in a manufacturing organization

• Strong SAP background with skills in financial, scheduling and materials planning is a must (Planview background an additional benefit)

• Very strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and manage teams not only in a traditional hierarchical organizational structure and but also enable teams in a matrix structure

• Demonstrates the courage and integrity to engage in difficult conversations with internal teams and management when needed, fostering transparency, growth, and collaboration

• Ability to build a highly collaborative and inclusive environment necessary for a team to be effective

• Strong communication and presentation skills, ability to present ideas in a clear and concise manner

• Fluent in English, German is a strong asset

descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face growing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer within our Mammalian Business Division either in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving sophisticated problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face growing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer within our Mammalian Business Division either in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving sophisticated problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Am Standort Visp bietet Lonza im Sustainability Team einen Praktikumsplatz im Rahmen des praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudiums (PiBS) in Zusammenarbeit mit der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) an.

Das PiBS-Modell ermöglicht Maturandinnen und Maturanden den direkten Einstieg in ein Bachelorstudium im MINT-Bereich, ohne vorgängiges Praxisjahr. Während des Studiums arbeiten die Studierenden 40 – 100% im Unternehmen (je nach Studiumsmodell) und besuchen parallel die Lehrveranstaltungen an der HSLU. So verbinden sie Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an.

Als PiBS-Studierende/r bei Lonza sammeln Sie wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem internationalen Life-Science-Umfeld und arbeiten aktiv an Projekten im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourceneffizienz mit, während Sie ihr Bachelorstudium an der Hochschule Luzern – Technik & Architektur absolvieren.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Allgemeine Tätigkeiten im Bereit Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenschonung mit Fokus auf Abwasserminimierung und CO2-Emissionen

• Mitwirken im Site Sustainability Team Visp zur Projekt Identifizierung und Umsetzung

• Bearbeitung von Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt, um Energien und Abwasserströme zu minimieren

• Technische Anlagenoptimierung mit Fokus auf Verbrennungs- und Verwertungsanalgen sowie Abwasserreinigungsanlagen

• Evaluierung von technisch und ökonomischen Machbarkeiten am Standort, um mittel- und langfristige Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen

Was wir suchen

• Maturant/in mit Studienplatz an der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) im PiBS (Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium) in den Studienrichtungen Energie- und Umwelttechnik sowie Maschinentechnik

• Interesse an den Themen Nachhaltigkeit, CO2-Reduktion und allgemeiner Ressourcenschonung

• Proaktive, selbständige und flexible Arbeitsweise

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache. Englischkenntnisse vorteilhaft

Über Lonza:
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)
Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du die Qualitätskontrolle der Biologics-Produktion am Standort Visp. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, dass Medikamente weltweit sicher und wirksam eingesetzt werden können. Der Job bietet Abwechslung, Verantwortung und attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – im modernen Labor und im gut strukturierten 4‑Schicht‑Modell.

Was du bekommst

• Ein modernes Laborumfeld mit erstklassiger Ausstattung.

• Eine inklusive, kollegiale Arbeitskultur mit klaren Entwicklungspfaden.

• ÖV-Unterstützung, Aktienprogramme, erweiterte Elternzeit und starke Pensionskassenleistungen; Alle lokalen Benefits am Standort Visp

• Drei interne Analysten-Stufen für eine Karriere ohne Führungsverantwortung und die Möglichkeit bis zu 150 verschiedene Methoden zu erlernen.

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Spezialisierungsmöglichkeiten.

Dein Arbeitsplatz
Unser Labor wurde 2022 neu gebaut – modern, effizient und technisch auf dem neuesten Stand. Wir leben eine offene Feedback-Kultur: Verbesserungsvorschläge von Analystinnen und Analysten werden ernst genommen, bewertet und aktiv umgesetzt (Kaizen-Prinzip). Wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden – gemeinsam und mit echtem Teamgeist.

Was du tust

• Du führst mikrobiologische, biochemische und physikalisch‑chemische Analysen unter GMP-Bedingungen durch, z.B. Bioburden, Endotoxin, HPLC / Chromatographie, UV oder TOC

• Du stellst im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb die zeitkritische Analyse und Freigabe von Produktions-Chargen sicher.

• Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen.

• Du unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse nach dem Kaizen-Prinzip.

• Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter – als Spezialist/in oder Generalist/in, je nach deinen Interessen.

Was du mitbringst

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in EFZ oder eine naturwissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung.

• Erste Laborerfahrung und GMP-Kenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Freude an präziser Laborarbeit, Verantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

• Deutsch-Kenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B1; Englisch-Kenntnisse von Vorteil.

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Modell (Frühschicht 5:00Uhr) und Wohnort in erreichbarer Nähe zu Visp.

• Hands-on Mentalität, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation für langfristige Entwicklung.

Über Lonza
Lonza zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Life‑Sciences‑Industrie. Unsere Teams entwickeln und produzieren gemeinsam Therapien und Technologien, die das Leben von Menschen weltweit verbessern. Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortung, Qualität, Leidenschaft und Integrität prägen unsere Arbeitsweise. Jede Idee – groß oder klein – kann einen Unterschied machen.
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden sich einbringen und weiterentwickeln können. Wenn du Teil eines Teams sein möchtest, das täglich an Lösungen für die Gesundheit von morgen arbeitet, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
