descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are seeking a Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations to lead the global technology agenda across development and manufacturing operations within a highly regulated life‑sciences / CDMO environment. The Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations is accountable for defining and executing enterprise technology strategy and architecture that enables digital manufacturing, data & AI, quality and compliance excellence, cybersecurity, and scalable growth. Operating in close partnership with the CIO and senior business leaders, this role ensures technology platforms deliver impact on yield, reliability, speed, compliance, and supply resilience across a multi‑site footprint. Key Responsibilities
• Enterprise Technology Strategy & Architecture: Define and execute a multi‑year enterprise technology strategy and roadmap covering cloud, data, AI/ML, OT/edge, and cybersecurity, aligned to corporate objectives and CIO enterprise standards.
• Digital Manufacturing & OT / IT Convergence: Lead Industry 4.0 initiatives across global sites, including advanced automation, real‑time release, predictive maintenance, robotics, and secure OT/IT integration.
• Data, Analytics & AI Enablement: Build and operate an enterprise data platform with strong metadata, lineage, and master data management foundations.
• Cybersecurity & Risk in Regulated Environments: Drive security‑by‑design across manufacturing, lab, product, and cloud platforms.
• GxP Compliance, Validation & Inspection Readiness: Institutionalize CSV/CSA approaches for GxP computerized systems across their full lifecycle.
• Innovation Portfolio & External Partnerships: Identify, evaluate, and incubate emerging technologies such as generative AI, digital twins, advanced sensors, and continuous manufacturing.
• Talent, Operating Model & Vendor Ecosystem: Build and lead high‑performing global engineering, data, and product organizations.
• Budgeting & Investment Governance: Co‑own technology investment planning (CapEx/OpEx), lifecycle management, and value realization. Required Experience & Qualifications
• 15+ years of global technology leadership experience, including responsibility for large‑scale platforms, engineering, and enterprise transformations across multiple sites.
• Proven delivery of digital manufacturing in GxP‑regulated environments with FDA/EMA exposure.
• Strong experience with OT/IT convergence and cybersecurity in regulated manufacturing environments.
• Experience within or with CDMOs, biopharma manufacturers, or similarly regulated life‑sciences organizations.
• Track record of innovation portfolio leadership with measurable business value.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nexus Internship Location: Visp, Switzerland Full Time, On Site. The role focuses on identifying business-relevant SAP AI use cases, assessing infrastructure readiness, and contributing to the design and development of a custom AI agent (“Customer Project Builder”) that automates the conversion of customer contract data into structured SAP project data. What you will get:
• 3 month internship working for a global organization
• Hands-on experience with a wide range of tools and implementing artificial intelligence capabilities
• A supportive team environment with training, coaching and clear development pathways. What you will do:
• Analyze and evaluate SAP AI technologies, including SAP Joule Co-Pilot and SAP Business AI capabilities
• Assess current SAP BTP landscape and identify infrastructure gaps for AI enablement
• Collaborate with Nexus IT and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize AI use cases
• Support development of SAP AI strategy recommendations and implementation roadmap
• Support the design and develop a custom AI agent (“Customer Project Builder”) for document-to-data automation What we are looking for
• Availability for full-time internship during the defined period
• Interest in working in a global, highly regulated industry (pharma/CDMO)
• Willingness to work in Visp and collaborate across locations
• Strong motivation to bridge business and technology About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
An unserem Standort in Visp, Switzerland suchen wir einen Praktikant (m/w/d) in QC Mikrobiologie. Die QC Mikrobiologie beschäftigt sich mit grossen Bereich von Mikrobiologie-Analysen und ist verantwortlich für die gesamte Mikrobiologie seitens Lonza, in Visp. Wir suchen einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) um unseres Team zu erweitern. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben: Durchführung einer Reihe von Analysen und Studien in der QC Mikrobiologie:
• Bioburden Analysen
• Endotoxin Analysen
• Keim Identifizierung
• Medienherstellung
• Sorgen für Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor
• Logistikarbeiten Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Biologielaborant (m/w/d), BSc Biologie, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
• Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Untersuchungen ist von Vorteil
• Erste Erfahrungen mit LIMS, iLAB oder MODA sind vom Vorteil
• Sichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Die QC Mikrobiologie beschäftigt sich mit grossen Bereich von Mikrobiologie-Analysen und ist verantwortlich für die gesamte Mikrobiologie seitens Lonza, in Visp. Wir suchen einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) um unseres Team zu erweitern. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben: Durchführung einer Reihe von Analysen und Studien in der QC Mikrobiologie:
• Bioburden Analysen
• Endotoxin Analysen
• Keim Identifizierung
• Medienherstellung
• Sorgen für Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor
• Logistikarbeiten Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Biologielaborant (m/w/d), BSc Biologie, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
• Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Untersuchungen ist von Vorteil
• Erste Erfahrungen mit LIMS, iLAB oder MODA sind vom Vorteil
• Sichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. What you will get
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Perform basic operational tasks in the lab (e.g mobile phase preparations, calibration of pH meter, balance check).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful Drug Product Services (DPS) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Associate Principal Scientist Process Development DP position. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Assist establishment of Drug Product process development infrastructure and services for parenteral drug products for clinical and commercial use
• Install, qualify, and maintain equipment for process development, non-GMP manufacturing and related analytics in close alignment with current best practices and regulations
• Plan and perform process development and characterization studies for liquid and lyophilized parenteral drug products of biologics (e.g. monoclonal antibodies, novel formats, ADCs, peptides) and small molecules
• Document data following applicable lab procedures and current documentation practices
• Act as project lead for assigned projects, being the customer’s SPOC for DPS activities
• Enable innovation and technical strategy projects, generate IP and contribute to scientific publications
• Execute analytical tests to support formulation and process development (e.g. HPLC and CE purity methods, content by UV, identity, color, clarity and opalescence, pH, osmolality, visible particles, subvisible particles)
• Manufacture non-GMP drug product samples for supportive stability studies and preclinical use (e.g. GLP tox studies) applying aseptic working techniques
• Support manufacture of clinical drug supplies at GMP sites What we are looking for:
• Science or engineering degree (PhD, MSc) in a relevant discipline, e.g. Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical or Biochemical Engineering, or a training on the job as lab technician, or equivalent
• Work experience as a research/technical assistant in the pharmaceutical or chemical industry, preferably in process development
• Understanding of Drug Product process development, and technical knowledge of handling basic analytical equipment e.g. UV-VIS, pH, osmolality
• Experience with parenteral dosage forms, protein formulation and analytics and aseptic working techniques is a plus
• Very good knowledge of reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results
• Strong communication skills and ability to work independently within a team
• Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence. Role Purpose: The Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence is critical for driving and overseeing the successful execution of strategic Quality Compliance programs/projects in alignment with the LGQ, IT, Operations, and the Quality Enabling Functions. This role is responsible for Lonza Quality Plan preparation and governance, managing the overall Compliance & Risk Management planning and reporting processes, facilitating Compliance, cross functional, and Global Quality Councils and serves as the touchpoint for to the leadership communications. The role serves as an ambassador and change agent for Compliance and Quality Excellence strategy and execution, in alignment with Lonza strategic imperatives, across platforms, functions, and regions. Key Responsibilities: Risk Management Framework Governance:
• Lead the governance framework providing guidance and support to managers across platforms and functions.
• Develops content for and facilitates strategic monthly leadership team meetings, as may be required.
• Supports development and monitoring of global Quality Councils, including action tracking/minutes and Quality Plans.
• Oversees Compliance programs/projects from initiation through to completion.
• Monitors program/project progress and performance, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
• Establishes/maintains project management standards and methodologies within in alignment with the One Lonza Vision Operates as SME/SPOC for competency areas, supporting troubleshooting, audits & inspections, etc. as required.
• Support sites and business platforms during regulatory inspections, complex investigations, and escalated compliance topics, as needed.
• Works closely with Compliance Head to complex manage escalations and address Executive leadership needs. Global Execution of Quality Compliance & QMS Strategy:
• Ensure operational execution of all strategic initiatives within Compliance & QMS, driving standardization and performance improvement.
• Drive and lead the implementation of change management within operational planning to embed new processes, systems, and ways of working.
• Oversee the development, monitoring, and reporting of the Lonza Quality Plan, ensuring visibility and accountability across functions.
• Monitor and drive global improvements benchmarking, and proactive risk mitigation. Data Analysis and Reporting:
• Prepare and present detailed reports on strategic Quality program/project performance, risk status and operational metrics.
• Manage the business reporting process (e.g., weekly huddle reports, monthly Quality reports, quarterly batch release review, etc.)
• Responsible for development of Quality KPI and KQI targets and monitors performance monthly (or as may be required based on projects, priorities). Stakeholder Engagement:
• Build strong relationships with Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Finance, and platform/site leadership teams.
• Use indirect leadership to drive decision-making and alignment in a matrixed global environment.
• Facilitate executive-level discussions, ensuring balance between strategic priorities and operational realities.
• Continuously influence stakeholders to maintain focus on long-term Quality Excellence goals. Skills:
• Strong leadership and team management skills.
• Excellent project management skills.
• Excellent Quality and Compliance experience.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• High attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Superior communication and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools. Key Requirements: Qualifications & Experience
• BSc or Masters degree in life science.
• PMP Certification ICH Q8,9,10 Proficiency preferred.
• Demonstrated success in managing large-scale, complex programs.
• Experience in developing and implementing risk management frameworks.
• Multisite leadership and Growth Projects experience
• Successful track record with Health Authorities inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.).
• Experience in managing complex multi-functional teams in a multinational business environment.
• Experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-national environment.
• Able to work in a matrix-team structure.
• Strong and proven leadership capabilities. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Werde Teil unseres Engineering‑Teams als Anlagetechniker Vibe-X 80-100% (m/w/d) in Visp. Bringe deine technische Expertise in ein Umfeld ein, das Qualität, Sicherheit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung lebt. Du betreust Umbau‑ und Neubauprojekte, optimierst Anlagen und stellst sicher, dass alle Instandhaltungsarbeiten reibungslos und termingerecht ablaufen.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Vorbereitung, Koordination und Durchführung von Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen unter Berücksichtigung von GMP-Aspekten unter Einbeziehung interner und externer Partner

• Überwachung von Instandhaltungsaufträgen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Tasks pünktlich ausgeführt werden

• Erstellen und Bearbeiten von Wartungsplänen und Checklisten in SAP PM

• Technische Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten im Bereich der pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Maschinen und Anlagen, von Instandhaltungsprozessen sowie von internen Abläufen

• Einhaltung gültiger Standards hinsichtlich Sicherheit, Hygiene, Umwelt, Qualität

• Mitarbeit bei der Überwachung und Einhaltung des zur Verfügung stehenden Budgets (Unterhalt, Umstellungen und Investitionen)

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufslehre (idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker)

• Berufserfahrung in Betrieb, Instandhaltung und Neubau von Maschinen und Anlagen bevorzugt in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma- oder Biotechindustrie

• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP, COMOS, SAP - von Vorteil

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten; starker Teamplayer; sehr guter Kommunikationsstil

• Handwerkliches Geschick sowie belastbare, lösungsorientierte und positive Persönlichkeit

• Englisch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift); Deutsch (gute Kenntnisse)

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein/e Prjoject Lead QC gesucht. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Abschätzung des Aufwands für Kunden in ausführlichen Projektplänen (zeitliche Planung, Ablaufplanung, vorläufige Abklärungen, Arbeitsergebnisse, Aufgleisen der Dokumentation und Einbeziehung der Qualitätssicherung)
• Koordination von Projekten und Betreuung der technischen Realisierung der Projekte während des Methodentransfers und anschliessende Beratung
• Berichterstattung über den Fortschritt eines Projektes und Eskalationen von Angelegenheiten, wenn dies erforderlich ist
• Initiierung und Fertigstellung von notwendigen prozessbezogenen Change Controls, Deviations und Laboruntersuchungen
• Verantwortlich für das Ausführen und die Organisation eines angemessenen Trainings von Mitarbeitenden innerhalb der QC, um die cGMP Compliance auf der Betriebsebene sicherzustellen
• Proaktives nachverfolgen von Entwicklungsaktivitäten innerhalb der zutreffenden Disziplin, zusammen mit dem Austausch von Wissen innerhalb der QC Organisation
• Erstellen, Überarbeitung und Review von cGMP Dokumenten (SOP`s, Qualitätsanweisungen, Protokollen, Berichten...), basierend auf dem Standardformat für Aktivitäten innerhalb der Qualitätskontrolle
• Nimmt an projektbezogenen Audits teil, falls anwendbar
• Schnittstelle zwischen den QC Angestellten und Auftragslaboren, um mögliche Verbesserungsvorschläge und deren Implementierung zusammen mit den Managern QC zu besprechen Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• PhD (Doktorat) in Chemie, Chemieingenieurwesen, Biochemie, Biologie, oder äquivalente Ausbildung; oder Bachelor, Master in einer entsprechenden Disziplin, mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
• Fortgeschrittene, wissenschaftliche Expertise auf dem Gebiet der Analytischen Chemie
• Fundierte, regulatorische (GMP & ISO 9001) Kenntnisse
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. For our site in Visp we are looking for a dedicated Batch Record Reviewer 80 - 100% (f/m/d) to extend our team. If you are passionate about applying your expertise to optimize drug product manufacturing and truly make a difference, we encourage you to explore this opportunity. Key responsibilities:
• Responsible for the planning, the execution and documentation of manufacturing campaigns for Drug Product in compliance to cGMPs, SOPs and applicable guidelines. Securing each batch is manufactured safely, on time, in compliance with the batch instructions and quality requirements.
• Provides front line technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing teams (operators), plant engineers and QA operations.
• Responsible to establish timely and with high quality the required production documentation (preparation and review of electronic batch records) or other relevant GMP documents for the assigned production area.
• Lead process related investigations and critical deviations and assists in decision making on production issues.
• Lead process changes, CAPAs, and CAPA effectiveness checks related to process within required timelines and through GMP systems (e.g. Trackwise, MES, training, etc.)
• Supports the execution of process validations, including planning and preparation of the required validation plans and reports, liaising with all the relevant parties at shopfloor to ensure accurate execution.
• Use scientific, process and statistical knowledge to analyze data to provide process understanding, and to identify root causes of product and process failures.
• Be highly knowledgeable of product and process trends by providing input to Annual Product Reviews and Product Quality Review for analysis.
• Be a resource to other departments as Subject Matter Expert for the product and process knowledge.
• Provide training for assigned new processes and products.
• Acts as Subject Matter Expert during customer audits and visits, maintain their processes at inspection readiness level and to provide the necessary support.
• Responsible to prepare and execute SHE, EM and operation risk analysis for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures.
• Executes innovation and improvement projects comprising general manufacturing aspects for the production plant. Key requirements:
• Bachelor / Master Degree.
• Preferred area of study: Pharmaceutical Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacy or equivalent scientific degree.
• Experience in Sterile Manufacturing on the shopfloor and/or QC/QA in an asset.
• Fluent in both German and English.
• Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution.
• Strong leadership skills and team orientation.
• Good communication skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization and on the shopfloor.
• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude; open-minded for new ideas and suggestions.
• High motivation and dynamic drive; solution-oriented.
• Proven IT knowledge, knowledge in ERFP (SAP) or MES (Syncade) is an asset.
• Prepared to work flexible working hours. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful Drug Product (DP) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the (Senior) Scientist Development Bioanalytics position. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Provide support in non-GMP bioanalytical testing within DPS Development Bio-Analytics to meet our customer’s needs
• Execute potency assays for method implementation, pre-validation, and sample testing with binding or functional assays
• Document assay performance following Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and ensure flawless execution, flagging relevant observations for further assessment
• Review and approve basic operational tasks performed and detailed by peer analysts, such as buffer preparation and calibration of pH meters or balances
• Contribute to investigations and troubleshooting for methods and lab equipment issues
• Adhere to 6S principles and internal standards for practical work performance and documentation to ensure audit readiness, supporting onsite customer visits
• Participate in laboratory operational optimization and process improvement initiatives
• Adhere strictly to applicable Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) regulations What we are looking for:
• Analytical lab technician, Bachelor and/or Master degree in Biology, Biotechnology, or other Life Science related fields (PhD or equivalent experience not required)
• Proven experience in Bioassays/Potency assays in the biopharmaceutical field
• Comprehensive understanding of cGMP rules and requirements
• Proficiency in various cellular and biochemical methodologies such as mammalian cell culture, ligand-binding assays (ELISA, HTRF, ECL), surface plasmon resonance, and flow cytometry
• Ability to report, interpret, and detail scientific results using electronic systems
• Eagerness to learn and carry out new and complex tasks

descriptionByLocale.it:
Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung. Am Standort Visp suchen wir einen Laboranten AD Microbial. Als Mitglied unserer Analytischen Entwicklungsabteilung (AD) entwickeln, optimieren und validieren Sie analytische Methoden in Kundenprojekten für mikrobiell hergestellte Biopharmazeutika. Sie arbeiten nach ISO und GMP-Qualitätsrichtlinien und nehmen sich im Labor den notwendigen administrativen Arbeiten wie der Dokumentation der Resultate, dem Erstellen von Arbeitsanweisungen und Berichten, sowie der Vorbereitung von Kundenpräsentationen an. Die abwechslungsreichen Verantwortlichkeiten beinhalten auch das Schulen von Mitarbeitern sowie das Betreuen von Praktikant/innen und/oder Auszubildenden. Darüber hinaus bearbeiten Sie eigenverantwortlich Ihnen zugeteilte Projekte in interdisziplinären Teams nach Absprache mit dem Projektleiter und tragen zur stetigen Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung und damit zum Erfolg des Unternehmens bei. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Entwicklung, Implementierung und Validierung von HPLC Assays (RP-/SE-/IEX-HPLC etc.)
• Erstellung und Revision der Studienprotokolle, Arbeitsanweisungen und Berichte in multiplen Studien entsprechend den GLP-Richtlinien
• Training und Entwicklung von Lehrlingen, Junior Laboranten und Praktikanten
• Implementierung neuer analytischer Technologien und Mitwirkung bei der Laborautomatisierung
• Planung Analysen und Geräte im Labor
• Geräteverantwortung Was wir suchen:
• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant der Fachrichtung Biologie, Chemie (oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation) mitmehrjähriger Industrieerfahrung
• Sie kennen sich mit HPLC/UPLC und Bioanalytik bestens aus und sind erfahren im Umgang mit ISO- und GMP-Standards
• Sie schaffen es als ergebnisorientierte Persönlichkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen die Übersicht zu bewahren und die entstehenden Herausforderungen mit Elan anzugehen
• Es macht Ihnen Spass, sich für unseren dynamischen Konzern einzusetzen und Sie schaffen es, sich auch in einer neuen Arbeitsumgebung zügig zu etablieren
• Neben Deutsch können Sie sich auch gut in Englisch verständigen
• Es fällt Ihnen sehr leicht, MS Office, CDS Empower, LIMS, DMS und Trackwise im Arbeitsalltag gewinnbringend einzusetzen. ​ Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Erstellung und Revision der Studienprotokolle, Arbeitsanweisungen und Berichte in multiplen Studien entsprechend den GLP-Richtlinien
• Training und Entwicklung von Lehrlingen, Junior Laboranten und Praktikanten
• Implementierung neuer analytischer Technologien und Mitwirkung bei der Laborautomatisierung

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are seeking experienced Bioprocess Engineers with significant work experience in biomanufacturing and a passion for Biotechnology to join our Lonza talent community. Become part of this exciting opportunity and apply now for the position as Senior Bioprocess Engineer. Key responsibilities:
• As Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will manage operational activities, e.g. tech transfer support, material planning, document and batch record preparation, training and troubleshooting, deviation handling
• Act as a functional lead for an interdisciplinary team of production personnel, supervisors and specialists and be accountable for the performance and results of assigned projects
• Guide and support activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing in one or more defined areas, e.g. capture, intermediate purification, polishing or drug substance filling
• Ensure efficient operation of single-use and/or stainless steel equipment for the purification of therapeutic proteins Key requirements:
• Bachelor, Master’s Degree or PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject
• Significant work experience in manufacturing in the biotech/biopharma industry e.g. chromatography, ultra-/diafiltration and dead-end filtration
• Very good GMP understanding
• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German
• Strong team orientation
• Structured, well-organized working attitude and solution-oriented working style
• Open-minded for new ideas and suggestions Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung. Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Ibex® Solutions ist ein modularer Komplex für die Entwicklung und Herstellung von biologischen Produkten. Unternehmen können damit auf eine Komplettlösung zugreifen, dabei an Schnelligkeit gewinnen und eine vereinfachte Wertschöpfungskette erreichen. Als Operator Utilities / Mitarbeiter Technischer Unterhalt (m/w/d) im Schichtbetrieb in Visp bist du für das Bedienen und Überwachen komplexer Bio-Produktionsanlagen verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen behebst du Störungen, führst Reinigungs- und Wartungsarbeiten durch, arbeitest unter anderem in Reinräumen und dokumentierst die Produktionsschritte. Auch in hektischen Zeiten behältst du den Überblick und schätzt den engen Austausch mit verschiedenen Funktionen (Biotechnolog:innen, Betriebsingenieur:innen, QA etc.). Was wir dir bieten:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen
• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Deine Aufgaben:
• Betrieb der Utilities (Clean Utilities, Black Utilities, HVAC und Abwassersysteme)
• Erkennen, Interpretieren und Beheben von Störungen und Abweichungen
• Abgleich betriebsübergreifender Prozessschritte (Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten, Abläufe)
• Koordination paralleler Tätigkeiten
• Erkennen und Setzen der richtigen Prioritäten Dein Profil:
• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre (EFZ) oder Technikerschule (HF) in der Fachrichtung Pharma/Chemie oder in der Sanitär-/Heizungsbranche
• Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (4-Schichtbetrieb) sowie Flexibilität in der Arbeitsplanung Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Deine Aufgaben:

• Betrieb der Utilities (Clean Utilities, Black Utilities, HVAC und Abwassersysteme)

• Erkennen, Melden, Interpretieren und Beheben von Störungen und Abweichungen

• Abgleich betriebsübergreifender Prozessschritte (Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten, Abläufe)

• Koordination paralleler Tätigkeiten

• Erkennen und Setzen der richtigen Prioritäten

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre (EFZ) oder Technikerschule (HF) in der Fachrichtung Pharma/Chemie oder in der Sanitär-/Heizungsbranche

• Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (4-Schichtbetrieb) sowie Flexibilität in der Arbeitsplanung

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. We are looking for a motivated and digitally driven professional to join our team as an Operational Excellence Specialist Digitalization. In this role, you will contribute to the improvement and digitalization of operational processes, combining digital solutions with Operational Excellence methodologies to enhance efficiency and performance in a manufacturing environment. This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get:

• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across operations and IT
• Development opportunities in OE and digitalization
• Dynamic and impactful working environment ​The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you will Do:

• Apply Operational Excellence principles to identify and implement improvements
• Translate operational needs into practical digital solutions
• Support the implementation and adoption of digital tools in production
• Improve data transparency, and support reporting and performance tracking
• Collaborate with Operations, IT, and cross-functional teams What we are looking for:
• Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, life sciences, IT, or a related field
• Initial experience in Operational Excellence, digitalization, and/or process improvement
• Experience in manufacturing or production environments is a strong advantage
• Strong digital affinity and interest in process digitalization
• Knowledge of Lean / Six Sigma or willingness to develop these skills e.g. via Green Belt project
• Structured, analytical mindset and hands-on approach
• Strong team player with good communication skills About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a DeltaV Automation Engineer or Electrical Instrumentation & Control Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in a dynamic, cutting-edge environment where your work will significantly contribute to shaping the future of medicine. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location
• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you will do:
• Planning and realization of electrical MSR readiness (maintenance, changeovers, improvements) within the available budget and timelines
• Ensuring seamless operation and flawless performance of high-automated Biologics facilities equipped with DeltaV and MES systems. Equivalent experience is also acceptable for educational requirements like MES
• Managing GMP-compliant activities, including testing, documentation, and change management using systems such as Kneat and Ubik
• Preparing and updating plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards
• Determining and implementing continuous improvements in equipment and maintenance processes to improve efficiency and reliability
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine internal procedures and achieve optimized workflows What we are looking for:
• Equivalent experience in Electrical or System Engineering or a related field, including University Degree or equivalent experience, or vocational education (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)
• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of pharmaceutical plants or the biotech industry
• Proficiency in SAP, COMOS (Plant Engineering Software), DeltaV (Process Control System), and MES Syncade (Manufacturing Execution System) is highly desirable
• Proficient in English and/or German to competently communicate in our diverse, collaborative environment
• Familiarity with GMP standards and protocols to ensure compliance in a regulated manufacturing setting
• A self-reliant, trustworthy, and effective working approach that ensures successful completion of tasks and projects Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. • Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Selbstständiger Unterhalt und Störungsbehebungsarbeiten von Waagen
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards während aller Tätigkeiten
• Dokumentation nach GxP Richtlinien (Datenintegrität)
• Neuinstallation und Inbetriebsetzung von Waagensystemen Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Automatiker EFZ, Elektroinstallateur EFZ, Elektroniker EFZ oder einem technischen Beruf
• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung
• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team
• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation
• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this great opportunity and apply now! Key responsibilities:
• You lead multi-functional teams tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale
• You act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and manufacturing
• You directly connect with customers during campaign preparation, execution and closure including regular reporting of batch status and process performance
• You are responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing considering all regulatory requirements
• You secure technology transfer success by applying standardized processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control Key requirements:
• Bachelor, Master's degree or PhD or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related field
• Significant experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferably in Mammalian Manufacturing (large-scale)
• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology
• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung. Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein Automatiker EFZ gesucht. Was wir dir bieten:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen
• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: assetstream.aspx Deine Aufgaben:
• Durchführung von Inbetriebsetzungsarbeiten und Störungsbehebung von EMR-Anlagen (Elektro-, Mess- und Regeltechnik)
• Präventive Instandhaltung von EMR-Anlagen
• Kalibrierung, Kontrolle und Handhabung von Messmitteln
• Dokumentation nach GxP Richtlinien (Datenintegrität)
• Übernahme von Pikettdienst bei Bedarf Dein Profil:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Automatiker EFZ, Elektroinstallateur EFZ, Elektroniker EFZ oder einem artverwandten Beruf
• Grundkenntnisse Mess- und Regeltechnik sind von Vorteil
• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung
• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team
• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. For our site in Visp, we are currently seeking several qualified Pipe Fitters / Metalworkers. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. Your Responsibilities:
• Professionally and cost-effectively measure, fabricate, and install complex piping systems and support structures in industrial piping construction
• Prepare isometric drawings and piping spool assemblies in accordance with technical specifications and project requirements
• Plan and organize work processes based on P&ID flow diagrams for project work and plant modifications
• Apply PED directives and work according to internal piping classes, plant standards, and quality assurance requirements Your Profile:
• Completed vocational training as a Plant and Apparatus Technician EFZ specializing in piping construction, Pipefitter, Heating Installer, or Plumbing Installer
• Several years of professional experience as a pipefitter or piping preparator/fabricator is an advantage
• Willingness to pursue continuous professional development
• Enjoy working across departments and capable of working independently and flexibly within a team
• Reliable, resilient, entrepreneurial mindset, with open and direct communication skills
• Good command of German, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. title: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.it: MSAT Process Expert Mammifero a monte su larga scala (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.en: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.de: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.fr: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this great opportunity and apply now! Key responsibilities:
• You lead multi-functional teams tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale
• You act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and manufacturing
• You directly connect with customers during campaign preparation, execution and closure including regular reporting of batch status and process performance
• You are responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing considering all regulatory requirements
• You secure technology transfer success by applying standardized processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control Key requirements:
• Bachelor, Master's degree or PhD or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related field
• Significant experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferably in Mammalian Manufacturing (large-scale)
• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology
• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world — and that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. The actual location of this role is in Visp. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. About the Role Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly within Operations and Process Development, we work at the intersection of process understanding, operational performance, process improvement, and data intelligence. We do not see data, dashboards, or GMP deliverables as isolated reporting activities. Every dataset, every process trend, every recurring manual task, every deviation investigation, and every operational pain point is an opportunity to improve how the organization operates. We are looking for a Process Analytics & Operational Intelligence Expert who combines process understanding, analytical thinking, operational curiosity, and technical data capabilities to help drive continuous improvement across process development and manufacturing environments. This role combines:
• Process analytics
• Operational intelligence
• Process improvement
• Data analysis
• Foundational data workflows
• GMP operational support
• Advanced process monitoring What You Will Do
• Build trusted, analytics-ready datasets by integrating, contextualizing, and structuring operational data from systems such as PI, MES, ELN, instrument platforms, and manufacturing data sources.
• Work closely with mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand how operational data is generated, used, and interpreted within real manufacturing and GMP workflows.
• Analyze process trends, variability, bottlenecks, and performance drivers across batches, campaigns, and workflows using statistical and analytical techniques.
• Develop operational dashboards, analytical views, and process intelligence solutions used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Manufacturing, QA, and Operations teams
• Translate complex operational and manufacturing datasets into actionable insights and improvement opportunities that support process robustness and operational performance.
• Support GMP deliverables and reporting activities while identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve underlying data and operational workflows.
• Improve operational data quality, traceability, contextualization, and usability to enable scalable analytics and reliable decision-making.
• Collaborate closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, IT, and global data teams to deliver scalable, operationally relevant, and production-ready data and analytics solutions. Who You Are
• You are passionate about turning complex process and manufacturing data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.
• You think beyond dashboards and reporting, focusing on how data can improve process understanding, operational performance, and decision-making.
• You are comfortable working close to mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand operational context, data meaning, and business needs.
• You enjoy working at the intersection of analytics, operational data, process improvement, and digital transformation.
• You are curious about how data is generated, structured, contextualized, and consumed across operational environments.
• You communicate clearly and can translate complex datasets and analyses into practical recommendations for operational and scientific stakeholders.
• You are hands-on, collaborative, and comfortable working across technical, scientific, and operational teams.
• You are motivated by solving real operational challenges and building scalable solutions that can be embedded into day-to-day operations. What You Bring Experience or strong exposure to:
• Operational analytics
• Manufacturing/process data
• Industrial or operational data environments Practical knowledge of:
• SQL
• Python
• Statistical analysis
• Dashboarding and visualization
• Data pipelines or ETL concepts Exposure to tools such as:
• Seeq
• Statistica
• SIMCA
• Power BI
• PI System
• Azure
• Git
• Or equivalent analytics/data platforms CDMO experience or understanding of mammalian manufacturing, process development, or bioprocess operations is strongly preferred. Interest in:
• Process behavior and variability
• Manufacturing operations
• GMP process support
• Continuous improvement
• Digital transformation Why Join PADI The Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team connects data assets and people to unlock operational performance, strengthen process understanding, and drive smarter decisions across the organization. PADI is embedded directly within Operations and Process Development, working closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, and global teams to solve real operational and process challenges through analytics, operational intelligence, and scalable data solutions. This is not a traditional data role. Every dashboard, GMP deliverable, workflow, and operational request is treated as an opportunity to improve processes, simplify complexity, increase scalability, and strengthen operational excellence. You will work at the intersection of:
• Operations
• Process Science
• Manufacturing
• Data Intelligence helping shape the future of data-driven process development and manufacturing in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven, and operationally connected environment. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Laboratory Scientist Phys-Chemical QC position. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you’ll do:
• Independently execute routine physico-chemical testing such as U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, protein content, and compendial methods (pH, color, clarity, subvisible particles, etc.) for biologics/large molecules, related entities and small molecules in QC under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) in a right-first-time and timely manner
• Executes/reviews/approves basic laboratory operational tasks, e.g. mobile phase preparation or calibration/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment
• Assist in investigation/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment issues by provision of technical knowledge on the equipment to the Business Process Owner
• Support maintaining the 6s standard within the laboratory by actively following and keeping up 6s processes for chemical inventory & consumables management, thereby ensuring audit/inspection readiness as well as supporting them.
• Leads organization and on time conduction of maintenance/requalification of assigned laboratory equipment, supported by external vendors, as Instrument Responsible Person (Cat A and B). Act as trainer for assigned equipment in combination of respective analytical methods
• Support analytical method validation or transfers as required
• Proactively contribute to laboratory operational optimization and process improvement initiatives
• Contributes to Pikett Service for Drug Product analytical infrastructure What we’re looking for:
• Training on the job as a lab technician (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA or BSc./MSc.)
• Working experience in a research/ technical role in the pharmaceutical, biotech or chemical industry, in analytical testing
• Proven working experience in a cGMP regulated environment in phys-chem analytics strongly desired with experience in accurately reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results following ALCOA++ GDocP principles
• Experience with laboratory specific software (e.g. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) is advantageous
• Good communication and ability to work independently in a team, proactive and dedicated attitude
• Good knowledge of written and spoken English. Any other languages are a plus About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. The Senior Strategic Buyer Indirect IT/OT will be part of the Indirect Procurement team and reports to the Head of Indirect Procurement Categories: Technology, Professional Services & MRO. The successful candidate will collaborate effectively with the Global IT/OT Category manager and other Category Managers to deliver value and continuous improvement to assigned sites and their stakeholders. The role of this person is to partner with key stakeholders to ensure business continuity and verify that procurement activities meet specific site business needs. You will provide essential purchasing expertise in tendering, negotiation, and contracting while managing the delegated spend. The hired candidate will be responsible for driving savings initiatives by developing a pipeline of projects and realizing cost reductions with delegated suppliers. You will manage supplier relationships in liaison with delegated spend, overseeing an annual portfolio of up to 50 million. You will also act as a support for the roll-out of new procurement policies, procedures, and tools, ensuring the optimization of transactional costs and efficiency across the organization. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Support Category Managers with category and sourcing strategy development by providing site-specific business needs and reporting local market trends.
• Execute sourcing initiatives for delegated spend across assigned sites, providing expertise in negotiation tactics and planning.
• Manage the supplier portfolio to leverage capabilities, improve supply continuity, and reduce the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
• Track country savings performance and identify potential risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Identify and partner with site stakeholders (Budget owners, Legal, etc.) to understand and support current and future business needs.
• Drive the utilization of leading-edge sourcing tools, including on-line catalogues and E-Auctions.
• Perform comprehensive supply risk assessments across the existing supplier portfolio, including financial and quality risks.
• Ensure the ERP system and RM documentation databases are accurately maintained. What we are looking for:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Procurement, or Supply Chain.
• 5–10 years of experience in Strategic Procurement; experience within the Pharma or a high-quality industry is preferred.
• Business fluent in English.
• Expertise in procurement processes: category management, supplier management, and contract management.
• Hands-on experience using SAP, Ariba, and Microsoft Office.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously.
• Ability to persuade and influence suppliers to achieve the best outcomes for the business.
• Knowledge of process improvement and a customer service-oriented mindset.
• Willingness to adhere to GMP standards and safety procedures at all times. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. For IbexTM Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept in Visp, Switzerland, we have multiple openings. Become part of this exciting opportunity and join our team by applying for the positions. Key responsibilities:
• Responsible for the planning, the execution and the documentation of project-specific process development activities in interaction with technicians for the execution of the work in the pilot plant.
