Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. As part of the MSAT (Manufacturing Science & Technology) Validation team of our Large-Scale Mammalian facility in Visp, we are looking for a Cleaning Validation Expert. In this role, you will be responsible for the cleaning validation related activities in our biopharmaceutical plant and help ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance. Key responsibilities:
• Develop and coordinate equipment cleaning validation strategy and activities for the assigned projects in the Large-Scale Mammalian facility of Lonza Visp in collaboration with operations, QA/MSAT cleaning and QC.
• Prepare, organize and execute project specific cleaning validation related documentation (protocols, reports, annual cleaning review) according to Lonza procedures and in compliance with regulatory.
• Reviewing and approving cleaning related documents (QC studies, risk assessment, etc.)
• Reviewing and approving of project specific cleaning validation documents (including clean/dirty hold time plan/reports, annual cleaning review of the facility)
• Coordinate troubleshooting and support investigations of deviations (and approve DR)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for non-conformity records, technical changes and change requests
• Be the main counterpart of cleaning experts
• Act as cleaning SME during inspections by healthcare authorities and customer audits. Key requirements:
• Master’s or PhD degree in biotechnology, life sciences, or related disciplines.
• Some working experience in biopharma cleaning and/or cleaning validation (preferably in mammalian manufacturing process).
• Working experience in cGMP-regulated biopharmaceutical environment and good understanding of the biologics manufacturing process and associated cleaning regulatory requirements.
• Proven experience in managing complex projects, ideally in MSAT or Quality.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines effectively.
• Exposure to process development, upstream/downstream processes, scale-up, and/or manufacturing (preferably mammalian cell culture) is an advantage.
• Experience engaging with regulatory agencies (Swissmedic, FDA, etc.) is an advantage.
• Excellent communication, technical writing, and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage.
• Able to come on site in Visp 80% of the time Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. descriptionByLocale.it:
In dieser vielseitigen Rolle unterstützt du das Trainingscenter aktiv bei der fachlichen Einführung neuer Mitarbeitender, der administrativen und qualitätssichernden Betreuung von Trainingsprozessen sowie der Weiterentwicklung moderner Lernformate. Für unseren Standort Visp suchen wir für 6-12 Monate einen Praktikant Training Center 80-100% (m/w/d). Was auf dich wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.
• Deine Aufgaben:
• Unterstützung beim technischen Onboarding durch Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Trainings in Biologie und Chemie
• Begleitung neuer Mitarbeitender während praktischer Trainingssequenzen zu GMP, Anlagen, Equipment und Sicherheit
• Pflege von Trainingsdaten und Qualifikationsnachweisen in den entsprechenden Systemen
• Organisation von Schulungsräumen, Lernstationen und benötigtem Equipment
• Beteiligung an Verbesserungsprojekten, z. B. Digitalisierung, VR/AR-Module oder Prozessoptimierungen
• Durchführung kleiner eigener Teilprojekte zur Weiterentwicklung des Trainingscenters
• Einbringen eines guten Gespürs für Marketingaspekte Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium, idealerweise Masterabschluss
• Biologischer Hintergrund von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich
• Erste Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Bearbeitung von Projekten wünschenswert
• Grundkenntnisse oder Interesse an der Erstellung von Matrixen
• Erfahrung in der Ausbildung von Mitarbeitenden, der Durchführung von Schulungen oder Tätigkeit im pädagogischen Umfeld von Vorteil
• Hohe Selbstständigkeit, ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und präzise Arbeitsweise
• Bereitschaft, sowohl fachliche als auch administrative Aufgaben zu übernehmen
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.
• Deine Aufgaben:
• Unterstützung beim technischen Onboarding durch Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Trainings in Biologie und Chemie
• Begleitung neuer Mitarbeitender während praktischer Trainingssequenzen zu GMP, Anlagen, Equipment und Sicherheit

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein Laborant (m/w/d) für die Qualitätskontrolle mit fachlichem Schwerpunkt in der Mikrobiologie gesucht. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Durchführung mikrobiologischen Methoden (z.B. Endotoxin, Bioburden, Keim Identifizierung) im GMP-Umfeld
• Kontrolle und Freigabe von Resultaten
• Betreuung und Qualifizierung von Laborequipment
• Untersuchen von Abweichungen und unerwarteten Resultaten
• Betreuung von Lehrlingen Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• Berufsausbildung als Labarant, Biologie oder Chemie
• Praktische Laborerfahrung in der Mikrobiologie
• Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
• Erfahrung mit IT-Systemen der Qualitätskontrolle (z.B. LIMS) ist von Vorteil
• Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Do you want to play a key role in ensuring the quality of raw materials behind the life-saving therapies of the future? This is a rare opportunity to join a small, dynamic QA team within Materials Management & Supply Chain, where your expertise will directly influence how quality processes for administering and controlling of raw materials are built, optimized, and made fit for the future. In this fast‑evolving environment, you’ll work across global processes and collaborate closely with various suppliers, internal departments, and other sites. You will use systems such as SAP, DMS, and TrackWise to drive change and ensure compliance and contribute to shaping new QMS platforms. This highly cross‑functional role offers strong development opportunities, especially as the organization grows. Are you keen to be part of an exciting grown project? Check out Your Career in Drug Product Services at Lonza! What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk What you will do:
• Act as QA SPOC for Material Management related topics for a new warehouse (under qualification), including and for defining GMP-requirements for material handling, segregation, cleanliness, traceability, storage conditions and contamination control.
• Own raw material quality processes, including support to new material introductions, review and approval of material specifications and raw material qualification process. Support with quality agreements if required.
• Execute drug substance batch disposition decisions and oversee material release.
• Contribute to Warehouse and Logistics quality oversight, maintain material master data, and participate in audits and inspections.
• Handle deviations, OOS/OOE investigations, and change control and create, review and approve SOPs.
• Lead and support cross-functional projects, train team members, collaborate with internal and external partners. What we are looking for:
• Solid work experience in QA in the GMP controlled environment, including handling deviations and CAPA activities.
• Experience with warehouse management / material management / raw materials is an advantage.
• Sound scientific or technical education background
• Fluency in English is a must. German language skills are an advantage.
• Ability to work accurately and efficiently in a regulated environment with a strong quality mindset.
• Collaborative, proactive approach with the ability to engage across cross‑functional teams and adapt to evolving processes.
• You are happy to be present onsite 5 days of the week About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung. Was auf Sie wartet
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort
• Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits Ihre Aufgaben
• Sicherstellung des reibungslosen und sicheren Anlagenbetriebs während Pilotierungs‑ und Produktionskampagnen, inklusive Betreuung ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten (Pikettdienst)
• Erstellung, Pflege und Änderung cGMP‑konformer Dokumentation (HSP, SOPs, Checklisten) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit MSAT/Betriebsbiotechnologie
• Frühe Einbringung betrieblicher und technischer Anforderungen in der Planungs‑ und Engineeringphase von Projekten
• Koordination und Unterstützung von Engineering und Werkstatt bei technischen Vorbereitungen, Anlagenmodifikationen und Investitionen
• Überwachung der Produktionsdurchführung, inkl. sofortigem korrigierendem Eingreifen bei Abweichungen
• Anlagentechnische Schulung und Instruktion von Mitarbeitenden während der Produktionsphase

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. The Material Management Analyst is responsible to perform all duties to ensure the performance of the team is on track and tasks are completed. Responsible for liaising with all key functions to ensure timely updates and analysis to materials. Execution of key tasks to support Lonza’s inventory and optimization initiatives. Ensure effective management of the material portfolio and its lifecycle control. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs. What you will get: An agile career and a dynamic work culture. An inclusive and ethical workplace. Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Support the Material Management Head in coordinating the MRP team, ensuring alignment on key priorities and processes.
• Generate and oversee material-related KPIs, implementing corrective actions and improvements to enhance material availability visibility.
• Manage the raw material portfolio of the supply chain in planning systems, including lifecycle control, and execution of large-scale master data updates and monitoring of the created Planning Orders, Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders.
• Reporting of Purchase Order related activities to external Audit Companies.
• Provide expertise in the management of specialized material categories.
• Participates in supply chain development initiatives brining material management expertise. Executes material related projects.
• SAP & AFI Key User – primary reference for system expertise and user support
• Material coverage analysis for Visp site – defines next steps and future strategy (projects supported by Lonza EC Board Level)
• Core Team Member, key role with analyzing current processes and making a significant contribution to the restructuring the Supply Chain Organization in Visp (MRP & MPL)
• Responsible for (SMOG) Scrapping Approval Workflows. Initiating, track and trace – ensuring accurate inventory level and timeliness for financial improvements for all 3 business platforms
• Preparing the reports for the MRPs to check SMOG items for monthly accurate SMOG submission.
• Preparing and submitting the monthly file for departments to check SMOG Liability to customer.
• Core Team Member - Value Stream Mapping Material Management, supporting process optimization and improvement
• Maintaining and analyzing safety stock levels for the Visp site to ensure optimal inventory availability/ Replenishment Policy
• Supporting the Head of Supply Chain by preparing and analyzing multiple reports for decision-making
• Providing cross-departmental support (QC, Plant Logistics, SC) with ad-hoc reports and analysis
• Training and onboarding new employees on SAP usage, ensuring knowledge transfer and faster integration What we are looking for:
• Degree or equivalent experience in SCM, Procurement or any relevant field
• CPIM, APICS Certification would be desired
• Min. of 5 years’ experience as a Material Requirement Planner or Analyst
• Experience in SCM, Materials Planning/Scheduling and/or Purchasing
• Good knowledge of SAP, especially MM and MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI
• Especially Presentation and Data Analytical skills are required.
• Good communication and presentation skills
• Fluency in English is required. German desired
• Strong Teammate and able to work across cross-functional teams About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? App Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• As an auditor, prepare, execute and conduct assigned internal audit activities; as a manager, plan lead and deliver internal audit assignments, including coverage of occasional consulting / advisory engagements and special projects in all operational areas (sourcing and procurement, inventory management, marketing & sales, production, human resources, finance & accounting)
• As an auditor, support and cooperate with the audit team; as a team lead, train, supervise and guide team member(s) and/or outsourced experts assigned to individual engagements
• Present audit results to stakeholders; prepare clear and concise audit reports that effectively communicate key findings, root causes, and associated risks.
• Cooperate with internal experts to optimize audit preparations and execution with data analytics and SAP configuration reviews; support corresponding activities related to ongoing improvements of audit programs and processes
• Participate in discussions with the finance organization and global process owners, especially regarding best practices as well as standardization and harmonization of processes and controls
• Follow-up on audit recommendations’ implementation and support the reporting on open and overdue issues to top management
• Lead initiatives and/or contribute to other internal activities and projects constantly optimizing the Internal Audit function Minimum Required Qualifications / Skills:
• Master degree preferably in finance / accounting, degree in chemistry or similar also welcome
• 3+ years of external audit experience mandatory (preferably experience from manufacturing industries); CPA (or equivalent professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CA) highly desirable
• Very experienced in executing assignments in compliance with international auditing standards; excellent understanding of standard business processes like S2P, OTC, R2R with solid know-how of SAP
• At least basic knowledge of IT fundamentals; competence to execute audits of operational and finance activities which are run with special applications
• Passionate about leveraging AI and digital tools; knowledge of ETL concepts and familiarity with SQL, Python programming and/or Power BI dashboards a plus
• Good analytical skills, risk focused, target and deadline oriented, result driven and solution developer, motivated self-starter
• Team player and very good communicator with leadership skills and potential to develop career further within the Lonza Group after 3-4 years in internal auditing
• Excellent command of written and spoken English
• Travel requirements approximately 10-20%

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Ensure the effective implementation and continuous improvement of hygiene standards at the Visp site
• Act as an interface and key link between all departments involved in contamination control, including Production, QA, Monitoring, Engineering and EHS
• Plan, lead and execute hygiene projects in the areas of material transfer, gowning, cleaning, disinfection and cleanroom behavior
• Take responsibility for planning, coordinating, and performing Cleanroom Performance Qualifications (PQs) in compliance with GMP and site requirements
• Prepare, maintain and update hygiene-related documentation in accordance with GMP standards
• Investigate deviations within hygiene and environmental monitoring processes, perform root cause analyses, define and track CAPAs
• Initiate and own related change requests (CRs)
• Manage and execute deviation investigations and ensure timely closure in compliance with quality system requirements
• Identify and implement improvement measures to harmonize and standardize hygiene processes across different production areas
• Prepare and represent hygiene topics during internal and external audits as well as inspections by authorities and customers
• Develop and deliver targeted training programs to strengthen hygiene awareness, and consistent hygiene standards across the site What we are looking for:
• Degree or vocational education in a scientific discipline such as Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Technology, Pharmacy, Bioprocess Engineering, or equivalent
• Professional experience in a GMP-regulated environment, ideally in contamination control, cleanroom hygiene, or quality management
• Strong knowledge of GMP regulations and experience in preparing and maintaining GMP documentation (SOPs, CAPAs, deviations, change controls)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our campus in the heart of the Swiss Alps, we are looking for a (Senior) QA Specialist, Material Management (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will provide independent QA review and approval for quality‑related activities involving raw materials and consumables, ensuring documentation, data, and processes meet internal standards and regulatory requirements, while supporting cross‑functional quality alignment. 

What you will get: 

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Serve as the QA point of contact for quality‑related questions and issues related to QC documentation for raw materials and consumables. 

• Perform independent QA review and approval of QC documentation, including Reference CoAs, specifications, and sampling taking procedures. 

• Prepare and approve risk assessments and product statements. 

• Review and approve SAP material workflows and quality‑relevant master data. 

• Assess, review, and approve quality records such as deviations, change controls, CAPAs, investigations, and effectiveness checks. 

• Ensure all QA activities are performed in compliance with applicable SOPs, internal standards, and regulatory expectations. 

• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, MSAT, QA Supplier Management, QC, and Regulatory Affairs. 

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Life Sciences/ Pharmacy/ Chemistry or a related scientific discipline. 

• Proven experience in a QA or QC environment within a regulated (GxP) industry. 

• Solid knowledge of quality systems (e.g., Trackwise), including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and investigations. 

• Experience reviewing and approving QC documentation. 

• Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and quality‑relevant master data is an advantage. 

• Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. 

• Good team player, willing to learn and grow with the team. 

• Fluent English skills, German is an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our campus in the heart of the Swiss Alps, we are looking for a (Senior) QA Specialist, Material Management (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will provide independent QA review and approval for quality‑related activities involving raw materials and consumables, ensuring documentation, data, and processes meet internal standards and regulatory requirements, while supporting cross‑functional quality alignment. 

What you will get: 

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Serve as the QA point of contact for quality‑related questions and issues related to QC documentation for raw materials and consumables. 

• Perform independent QA review and approval of QC documentation, including Reference CoAs, specifications, and sampling taking procedures. 

• Prepare and approve risk assessments and product statements. 

• Review and approve SAP material workflows and quality‑relevant master data. 

• Assess, review, and approve quality records such as deviations, change controls, CAPAs, investigations, and effectiveness checks. 

• Ensure all QA activities are performed in compliance with applicable SOPs, internal standards, and regulatory expectations. 

• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, MSAT, QA Supplier Management, QC, and Regulatory Affairs. 

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Life Sciences/ Pharmacy/ Chemistry or a related scientific discipline. 

• Proven experience in a QA or QC environment within a regulated (GxP) industry. 

• Solid knowledge of quality systems (e.g., Trackwise), including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and investigations. 

• Experience reviewing and approving QC documentation. 

• Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and quality‑relevant master data is an advantage. 

• Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. 

• Good team player, willing to learn and grow with the team. 

• Fluent English skills, German is an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our team to translate process requirements into clean, efficient MES, while continuously identifying optimization opportunities across system interfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with MES management, process owners, and cross‑functional partners to enhance data flows and further develop integrations with ERP, LIMS, and automation systems. If you enjoy combining process know‑how with hands‑on programming to improve manufacturing workflows, this role is for you. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk 

What you will do:

• Work closely with MES manager, system users and process owners to develop and revise MES recipes in a timely manner using Typescript

• Configure production recipes using a library of objects and manage MES master data like Products, Locations, Equipment, Materials

• Assist in fulfilling requirements of quality records such as process change controls, CAPA and deviations

• Draft and execute test script for the validation of recipes (IQ, OQ, PQ)

• Establishment and further development of interfaces to other systems such as ERP, LIMS and automation and work closely with this departments

• Development of concepts for an optimal data flow with the interfaces, taking into account all use cases. Definition of requirements for the MES system for its further development

• Support production via the Helpdesk, assisting with production issues

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience with MES in a programming/modeling capacity (not only as an end user). Previous exposure to any of the commercial MES systems (Rockwell PharmaSuite, Werum Pas-X, POMS, Emerson Syncade)

• GMP manufacturing experience is a must (specifically Fill & Finish or sterile/aseptic manufacturing is a plus)

• Academic degree (e.g. in IT) is an advantage

• Programming experience is a must. Hands‑on TypeScript experience is a plus

• You enjoy working cross-functionally, communicating with various stakeholders and you enjoy looking for ways to optimize processes.

• Fluent English; German is a plus and willingness to learn is expected.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein/e Labor Equipment Expert- /in gesucht. Als Mitglied des QC Labor Support Teams übernehmen Sie unter Einhaltung der geltenden Qualitäts‑ und Sicherheitsrichtlinien vielfältige Aufgaben zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Lifecycles von Laborequipment. Neben all den Routineaufgaben an den Geräten, erledigen Sie auch spontan auftretende Aufgaben. In Ihrer Funktion stehen Sie in regelmässigem Austausch mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen, unter anderem mit den Laboren, der Logistik sowie der Qualitätssicherung. Was wir ihnen bieten:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen
• Neben wettbewerbsfähigen Gehältern finden Sie eine breite Palette an Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteilen. Je nach Standort können diese Vorteile Familienzulagen, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Rabatte für lokale Unternehmen und Attraktionen, Reisekostenzuschüsse und subventionierte Mahlzeiten umfassen. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Sicherstellung des gesamten GMP Lifecycles von Geräten über Bestellung, Qualifizierung, Wartung, Reparatur, Requalifizierung bis hin zur Dekommissionierung der Geräte.
• Organisation / Betreuung von externen und internen Servicetechnikern.
• Bearbeitung aller nötigen Dokumente, welche für die Geräte relevant sind.
• Mithilfe bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen / Trouble Shooting.
• Abarbeitung von spontanen Anfragen aus dem Labor. Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, bevorzugt im Laborumfeld .
• Sie sind selbstständig, verantwortungsbewusst und besitzen eine gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.
• Sie sind bereit, sich in ein Team zu integrieren, sind engagiert, motiviert und besitzen eine gute Eigeninitiative.
• Arbeitserfahrung im GMP Umfeld wird bevorzugt
• EDV Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams usw.) werden vorausgesetzt, Laborsoftwares wie LIMS sind ein Vorteil.
• Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil. Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein/e Labor Equipment Expert- /in gesucht. Als Mitglied des QC Labor Support Teams übernehmen Sie unter Einhaltung der geltenden Qualitäts‑ und Sicherheitsrichtlinien vielfältige Aufgaben zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Lifecycles von Laborequipment. Neben all den Routineaufgaben an den Geräten, erledigen Sie auch spontan auftretende Aufgaben. In Ihrer Funktion stehen Sie in regelmässigem Austausch mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen, unter anderem mit den Laboren, der Logistik sowie der Qualitätssicherung. Was wir ihnen bieten:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen
• Neben wettbewerbsfähigen Gehältern finden Sie eine breite Palette an Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteilen. Je nach Standort können diese Vorteile Familienzulagen, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Rabatte für lokale Unternehmen und Attraktionen, Reisekostenzuschüsse und subventionierte Mahlzeiten umfassen. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Sicherstellung des gesamten GMP Lifecycles von Geräten über Bestellung, Qualifizierung, Wartung, Reparatur, Requalifizierung bis hin zur Dekommissionierung der Geräte.
• Organisation / Betreuung von externen und internen Servicetechnikern.
• Bearbeitung aller nötigen Dokumente, welche für die Geräte relevant sind.
• Mithilfe bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen / Trouble Shooting.
• Abarbeitung von spontanen Anfragen aus dem Labor. Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, bevorzugt im Laborumfeld .
• Sie sind selbstständig, verantwortungsbewusst und besitzen eine gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.
• Sie sind bereit, sich in ein Team zu integrieren, sind engagiert, motiviert und besitzen eine gute Eigeninitiative.
• Arbeitserfahrung im GMP Umfeld wird bevorzugt
• EDV Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams usw.) werden vorausgesetzt, Laborsoftwares wie LIMS sind ein Vorteil.
• Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil. Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join our Manufacturing Operations team in Visp, where you will play a key role in delivering life‑changing biopharmaceuticals. As a Bioprocess Engineer USP, you will drive operational excellence in Downstream Processing, ensuring safe, compliant, and on‑time execution of manufacturing campaigns in a state‑of‑the‑art biotech environment. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Plan, execute, and oversee USP manufacturing campaigns, ensuring safety, quality standards, and on‑time‑in‑full delivery.
• Evaluate process performance, interpret test results, troubleshoot USP equipment, and recommend solutions to operational issues.
• Prepare and execute SHE, EM, operational, and cleaning risk assessments for assigned products.
• Author, review, and maintain GMP‑relevant documents, SOPs, tech transfer documentation, recipes, and EBRs.
• Prepare, review, and support quality records including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and investigations.
• Perform or support qualification activities for equipment, manufacturing suites, and automation systems (MES/DeltaV).
• Lead USP operational readiness activities, including process validation, training, in‑process control, and other startup‑phase deliverables. What we are looking for:
• A BSc or MSc in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline with proven experience in USP manufacturing, or a candidate without an academic degree but with 7+ years of hands‑on experience in USP operations or a similar role.
• Solid expertise in GMP environments, USP workflows, troubleshooting, and bioprocess equipment.
• Experience with MES/DeltaV recipe creation, execution, or review is a strong advantage.
• Structured and proactive way of working with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams.
• Strong communication skills and readiness to support customer audits.
• Ability to lead tasks independently and contribute to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty/Pikett. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. What you will do: The Master Data department in Visp is a global team responsible for the development of master data processes and standards that are to be followed by the whole organization. As an intern, you will play an active role in:
• Perform various data analyses and reports to support Master data or Business projects
• Assisting with SAP Master Data mass maintenance and migration efforts
• Gathering feedback from global and local Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across the organization
• Defining functional and technical requirements for the development or enhancement of Master Data processes
• Updating and improving training materials, and delivering hands-on training sessions to teams across Lonza As a part of the Global Master Data team, you will be able to learn SAP Materials Management (MM), Production & Planning (PP) and Sales & Distribution (SD) modules, key business processes as well as SAP data structures. Overall, you will interact with many different departments and experts across the company worldwide. What we are looking for:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in data science, computer science, business information technology, or mathematics
• Solid understanding of data structures or hands-on experience with databases
• Proficiency in English; German and other languages are a valuable plus
• A passion for optimizing processes, improving IT tools, and exploring innovative solutions
• You are interested in being a reliable team member in a multi-cultural environment. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful Drug Product Services (DPS) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the QA Expert Analytics DPS position. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Establish and maintain Quality Management System for Drug Product Services
• Ensure proper qualification of Drug Product Services staff and adherence to GMP for stability studies and reference standards
• Review and approve analytical methods, qualification/validation/transfer protocols and reports as well as analytic related SOPs
• Supervise and execute GMP compliance activities and act as last approver of deviations for Analytics/Quality Control and OOS investigations
• Act as first contact concerning compliance issues for local and shared systems (e.g. LIMS) including approval of specifications in LIMS
• Counsel different groups on projects and GMP aspects What we are looking for:
• Academic degree (Master or higher) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field
• Minimum 5-6 years working experience in Quality Assurance in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP controlled environment, preferable in QC.
• Good working knowledge in EU and US GMP regulations relevant for audit/inspections, qualification/validation, compliance systems
• Sound knowledge in testing of biological drug products
• Excellent communication, decision making skills and ability to provide solutions for complex challenges
• Ability to work independently and a team player, being detailed oriented, precise, pro-active and well organized
• Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
This role provides essential support to the Legal Department on corporate governance, commercial register filings, and administrative excellence. You will act as a key coordinator for all Swiss Lonza entities, ensuring legal compliance and operational efficiency while working closely with legal counsel and international stakeholders. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
• Benefits in Basel: https://bit.ly/3HZNGv2 What you will do:
• Manage all commercial register updates (entries, changes, and deletions) for Swiss Lonza entities, drafting resolutions and ensuring regulatory compliance.
• Support the administration of contracts throughout their lifecycle using the CLM tool (e.g. maintaining contract records, updating metadata, tracking deadlines, and coordinating review and signature processes including notarization as needed).
• Take ownership of the Legal Proceedings Report (LPR) three times a year, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted on schedule.
• Conduct in-depth research to assist the legal team in navigating complex corporate or commercial legal matters and routine legal inquiries.
• Act as a liaison between the legal department, international law firms, and notary offices to drive cross-border projects.
• Oversee the Basel legal team’s shared inbox, handle travel arrangements, process expenses, and manage vendor invoices and payments.
• Organize global retreats and events while maintaining an efficient archiving system for all critical legal documentation. What we are looking for:
• 5–10 years of experience in a Paralegal role, either within an in-house legal department or a private law practice.
• In-depth knowledge of legal terminology, corporate law principles, and the ability to analyze complex documents for accuracy.
• Advanced computer skills and experience managing digital signature platforms and financial processing tools.
• Business fluency in English and German is required; French proficiency is a significant advantage for managing Swiss entity filings.
• Ideally an Executive Assistant with legal experience, a Paralegal certificate, or a University degree in Law (BLaw/MLaw) or Business.
• A respectful, patient, and tactful communicator who thrives in a collaborative team and handles confidential information with the utmost integrity.
• The ability to prioritize a high volume of information under tight schedules while remaining flexible to support the team’s needs. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Location: Visp (Switzerland) Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. This position is based in the quaint and beautiful town of Visp! Ibex Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular complex for the development and production of biological products. It gives companies access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain. The Ibex complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow! Would you like to be a part of this? Start your career at Lonza and apply as a Project Leader Quality Control today! Communicate with manufacturing, QA, and external customers. Represent QC in cross-functional teams and align strategies with other departments. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. Depending on your location, these benefits could include family allowances, childcare support, discounts for local businesses and attractions, travel allowances and subsidized meals. Key responsibilities:
• Establishing and maintaining customer relationships
• Preparing and supporting production campaigns
• Processing change requests and deviations under GMP
• Supporting customer audits and inspections by authorities
• Calculating and monitoring QC costs in the project
• Independent coordination, prioritization and scheduling of tasks Key requirements:
• PhD or equivalent experience in the Life Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry or Pharmaceutical Sciences)
• Work experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnological GMP environment and in Quality Control is a strong Plus
• Your assertive, clear and direct communication style allows you to work closely with different collaborators in a professional manner. You enjoy working with many people in various business areas and bring solid organizational and project management skills to handle demanding projects.
• Proficient use of common software applications (MS Office) is required. Knowledge of individual pharmaceutical/laboratory software (e.g. Documentum, LIMS, Trackwise) is an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it: Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join our Engineering team and help shape the future of performance, reliability, and sustainability at our Visp site. In this role as Reliability & Performance Manager 80-100% (m/f/d), you will drive the definition and tracking of Engineering KPIs across all sub‑groups, evaluate maintenance and CQV activities to optimize cost and performance, and assess CAPEX effectiveness. You will also take ownership of sustainability initiatives by defining goals, KPIs, and projects, while acting as the key interface to our global sustainability program. What you’ll get: • An agile career and dynamic working culture • An inclusive and ethical workplace • Compensation programs that recognize high performance • In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you’ll do: Reliability & Performance Management • Define, implement, and continuously improve Engineering KPIs across all groups (Maintenance / Plant Engineering, CQV, EI&C, Utilities, Projects). • Perform systematic bad actor analysis (equipment, systems, processes) using failure data, maintenance history, deviations, and cost drivers. Lessons Learned for projects. • Evaluate maintenance strategies and execution (preventive vs. corrective vs. runtime, backlog, cost structures) and identify optimization potential to reduce total OPEX cost. • Review CQV activities and lifecycle performance, ensuring cost‑effective execution while maintaining GMP and quality compliance. • Analyze asset performance data and translate findings into actionable improvement measures and standards. CAPEX Performance & Governance • Evaluate CAPEX performance for Engineering projects (cost, schedule, reliability impact). • Identify recurring weaknesses and improvement levers across the project lifecycle (design, execution, handover, early operation). • Support Engineering leadership with data‑driven insights for CAPEX prioritization, lessons learned, and performance reviews. Sustainability • Define sustainability‑related goals, KPIs, and Engineering projects in alignment with INB and site strategy. • Act as local Engineering interface to the global sustainability program, including reporting, alignment, and contribution to global initiatives. • Identify and drive Engineering‑led sustainability improvements (energy, water, utilities, asset efficiency, lifecycle optimization). Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement • Establish transparent KPI dashboards and reporting routines for Engineering leadership. • Drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement across Engineering processes. • Act as a sparring partner for Engineering managers on performance, cost efficiency, and reliability topics. What we are looking for: • Bachelor’s degree (BSc) in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering; MSc preferred. • 5–10 years of advanced professional experience in Engineering, Operations, or CAPEX project environments. • Strong technical understanding with experience in Engineering, Operations, or CAPEX projects. • Proven project experience and the ability to evaluate technical data and performance metrics. • Solid analytical and evaluation skills, including the ability to interpret complex engineering information. • Proficiency in SAP for maintenance, project, or asset‑related processes. • Business‑fluent English (required) and German (preferred). About Lonza: At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung. Sie wirken in einem qualitätskritischen Umfeld, in dem zielgerichtete Schulung und Qualifikation zentral sind. Durch strukturiertes Onboarding, kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und die Steuerung relevanter Trainings-KPIs stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑, Qualitäts‑ und Auditanforderungen sicher und stärken nachhaltig die Leistungsfähigkeit der Teams. Was auf Sie wartet: • Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur • Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld • Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen Ihre Aufgaben: • Entwicklung, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden wie zum Beispiel RP-, SE- und IEX-HPLC, icIEF, CE-SDS, UV/VIS-Spektroskopie und ELISA • Eigenständige Durchführung der geplanten Laborarbeiten gemäss dem definierten Zeitplan; angemessene Dokumentation der Rohdaten und Erstellen von Studienprotokollen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Berichten • Gewährleisten eines effizienten Laborbetriebs durch das Einhalten der Hygienevorschriften, Wartung und Unterhalt der Laborgeräte, Überwachung des Inventars und die rechtzeitige Beschaffung der Roh- und Verbrauchsmaterialien • Sicherstellen, dass die eigene Ausbildung auf dem neuesten Stand ist, einweisen und trainieren von Mitarbeitern auf spezifischen Instrumenten und Analysetechniken, flexibel und enthusiastisch, um auch andere Aktivitäten innerhalb der Abteilung zu unterstützen Was wir suchen: • Berufslehre als Chemielaborant oder Biologielaborant, oder Bachelors in Chemie, oder vergleichbar ist erforderlich • Praktische Erfahrung in der Durchführung einiger der oben genannten Analysetechniken, idealerweise mit HPLC • Erste Erfahrung mit GMP Umfeld ist ein Plus • Flexible, motivierte Persönlichkeit, die sich gut in Projekt-Teams integrieren kann und sich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten wohlfühlt • Gute Deutschkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift) sind benötigt und Grundkenntnisse in Englisch Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Based in Basel with the flexibility to travel as required, this role offers a seasoned IT professional the chance to provide world-class, personalized technical support to Lonza’s executive leadership and VIPs. You will be the face of IT for our highest-level stakeholders, ensuring that their technology is seamless, secure, and always optimized in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment. The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. What you will get: • An agile career and a dynamic work culture. • An inclusive and ethical workplace. • Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. • Benefits in Basel: https://bit.ly/3HZNGv2 What you will do: • Provide expert on-site and remote technical assistance, resolving hardware, software, and network issues with the highest level of professionalism and urgency. • Manage a specialized suite of mobile devices, laptops, and collaboration tools, ensuring secure VPN access and seamless communication for VIPs globally. • Take full ownership of AV and IT systems for board-level meetings and executive presentations, serving as the primary technical point of contact on-site. • Perform regular "health checks" on VIP equipment and environments to prevent downtime before it occurs, staying ahead of potential outages. • Build deep, professional relationships with executives to understand their unique technical preferences and provide personalized IT training to enhance their productivity. • Handle sensitive data and high-level interactions with absolute discretion, ensuring all support activities strictly adhere to global IT security policies. • Work closely with specialized IT teams and leadership to escalate complex issues and implement software updates with zero disruption to executive workflows. What we are looking for: • 3-5 years of experience in IT or Business Services, with a proven track record specifically in high-touch VIP or Executive support. • Advanced troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking, including mobile device management and secure meeting room technologies. • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to remain calm, composed, and discreet under extreme pressure from high-profile stakeholders. • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Management (or equivalent experience) and ITIL certification are required to ensure alignment with global service standards. • Business fluency in English is essential; fluency in German is highly preferred to support our stakeholders in Basel and beyond. • A logical thinker who can translate complex technical information into simple, actionable advice for non-technical users. • Flexibility to travel to residential or remote offices as needed and the agility to embrace change within a global corporate structure. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein QC Data Reviewer (m/w/d) für die QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. In dieser Position überprüfen Sie die Protokolle der Laboranten auf gute Dokumentationspraxis. Ausserdem sind Sie für die Identifizierung und Behebung von Fehlerquellen der Arbeitsroutinen verantwortlich. Da wir uns in einem kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess des Labors befinden, wird proaktive Mitarbeit und das Einbringen von eigenen mehr als wertgeschätzt. Ihre Aufgaben: • Sorgfältige Überprüfung von Analyseprotokolle. • Selbstständige Prüfung der Dokumentation und der Endergebnisse. • Enge Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit dem Laborteam, Wissenschaftler*innen und Projektleiter*innen. • Regelmässige Mitarbeiterschulungen zur Beseitigung von Fehlerquellen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit. • Aktive Beteiligung an der Laborplanung und Mitentwicklung von Verbesserungsprozessen. Ihr Anforderungsprofil: • Hochschulabschluss (FH/BSc/ MSc) oder mehrjährige Laborerfahrung. • GMP-Erfahrung von Vorteil, ist aber keine Voraussetzung. • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit LIMS wünschenswert. • Ein Hohes Mass an Selbstorganisation. • Eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie Freude an der Arbeit in einem jungen, motivierten Team. • Kommunikationsstärke und fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. Currently we are looking for Senior QA Specialists, who will work on our new growth project Vibe-X. As a member of a CAPEX projects Quality Project team, you will manage the QA related activities in close contact with QC, Engineering and Manufacturing to ensure the quality oversight is given. You will ensure timely delivery of project, even in the face of project requirements and priorities through excellent planning and management of the project. Join Lonza and apply for this innovative opportunity! Key responsibilities: • Responsible for project specific QA Operation work during commissioning/qualification and project tech transfer in IBEX • Assess and manage tasks that would impact Quality operation during GMP manufacturing • Plan for future activities and coordinate with other departments (e.g. QC, Engineering, Manufacturing) to complete the planned activities • Support day-to-day Quality Assurance activities in accordance with approved SOPs/Policies for a GMP manufacturing facility • Review GMP records to ensure compliance with cGMP per written procedures • Make real-time decisions on process events on the floor, based on knowledge of defined SOPs & policies • Participate in walkthroughs and audit/inspections Key requirements: • Bachelor of Science in Life Science or a related field • Significant experience in the pharmaceutical quality area • Work experience in a role in Quality Assurance, Production or Engineering, in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP controlled environment. QA experience in tech transfer is preferred • Excellent knowledge of computer systems (e.g. TW, SAP, etc.) and quality tools such as risk based approaches (e.g. FMEA) • Fluency in English Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Location. Visp. Rilocalizzazione, supportato. Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. # Cosa # Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica. • Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico. • Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni. • Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione. L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile anche su https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. ## Mansioni • Eseguire la produzione end-to-end di prodotti farmaceutici sotto GMP: esecuzione in batch, documentazione, risoluzione dei problemi e revisione dei risultati. • Completare e mantenere tutta la documentazione GMP (batch records, logbook, form). Cambiamenti di processo di supporto e attività CAPA. • Assicurarsi che ogni lotto sia fatto in modo sicuro, puntuale, e secondo standard qualitativi e asettici. • Impostare, operare e pulire le attrezzature per la produzione di fiala liquida e a tenuta stagna (lyophilized). • Supporto composto e formulazioni, preparazione tampone, lavaggio/autoclaving, test di integrità del filtro, riempimento/crimping e ispezione visiva. • Esperienza con manipolazione asettica all'interno di isolatori o cleanroom convenzionali, o lavorare con componenti ad uso singolo è un vantaggio importante. • Allena colleghi e supporta team interfunzionali con guida tecnica. • Segnala i problemi delle attrezzature e supporta i team di ingegneria con riparazioni in aree cleanroom/aseptic. ## Requisiti • 2–4 anni di esperienza di laboratorio GMP (Prodotto di farmaco sterile / Fill & Finish). • L'esperienza del prodotto della droga è un forte vantaggio. Apprendistato EFZ (meccanico o simile: meccanico di produzione, meccanico automobilistico, ecc.) Esperienza pratica anche nelle professioni con elevati requisiti di igiene e pulizia, come il cuoco/chef o ruoli comparabili. • Buone competenze in inglese per istruzioni e comunicazione; il tedesco è un plus. • Familiarità con GMP, SOP e processi di qualità. • Stile di lavoro affidabile, ben organizzato e orientato al team. • Conoscenza IT (SAP/MES è un plus). • Volontà a sostenere in una certa misura le funzioni di chiamata. • Attualmente operativo in un sistema a 2 turni; prontezza per il lavoro a 3 turni (settimana regolare di 5 giorni, sabato occasionale, domenica). ## Nota Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. descriptionByLocale.en: Location. Visp. Relocation, supported. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. What you’ll get: • An agile career and dynamic working culture. • An inclusive and ethical workplace. • Compensation programs that recognize high performance. • A variety of benefits dependant on role and location. The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you’ll do: • Carry out end‑to‑end Drug Product manufacturing under GMP: batch execution, documentation, troubleshooting, and review of results. • Complete and maintain all GMP documentation (batch records, logbooks, forms). descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

## Cosa offriamo
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available

## Mansioni
• Planning and realization of electrical MSR readiness (maintenance, changeovers, improvements) within the available budget and timelines
• Ensuring seamless operation and flawless performance of high-automated Biologics facilities equipped with DeltaV and MES systems. Equivalent experience is also acceptable for educational requirements like MES
• Managing GMP-compliant activities, including testing, documentation, and change management using systems such as Kneat and Ubik
• Preparing and updating plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards
• Determining and implementing continuous improvements in equipment and maintenance processes to improve efficiency and reliability
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine internal procedures and achieve optimized workflows

## Requisiti
• Equivalent experience in Electrical or System Engineering or a related field, including University Degree or equivalent experience, or vocational education (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)
• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of pharmaceutical plants or the biotech industry
• Proficiency in SAP, COMOS (Plant Engineering Software), DeltaV (Process Control System), and MES Syncade (Manufacturing Execution System) is highly desirable
• Proficient in English and/or German to competently communicate in our diverse, collaborative environment
• Familiarity with GMP standards and protocols to ensure compliance in a regulated manufacturing setting
• A self-reliant, trustworthy, and effective working approach that ensures successful completion of tasks and projects

## Contatto
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
