Cosa offriamo Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique • Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique • Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Vous trouverez ci-dessous la liste complète de nos prestations locales sur mesure. • Avantages dans Viège: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi ## Mansioni Le planificateur d'approvisionnement est responsable de diriger l'équipe de planification d'approvisionnement de bout en bout du site, assurant une exécution de production fiable, des niveaux d'inventaire optimaux et une disponibilité complète des matériaux pour toutes les opérations de fabrication. Ce rôle dirige les cycles hebdomadaires et mensuels de planification de l'offre, définit et gère le plan directeur de production (MPS), dirige la gouvernance de la planification et assure l'alignement entre la demande, la capacité et les contraintes de l'offre. Le planificateur d'approvisionnement dirige l'excellence de la planification, appuie les activités de S-P et agit comme partenaire clé des opérations, de l'AQ, de la SSM, de la logistique, de l'approvisionnement et de la gestion de projet. Ce rôle joue un rôle central dans la fiabilité de l'approvisionnement, l'appui aux projets de croissance et l'élaboration d'une stratégie de chaîne d'approvisionnement à long terme sur le site. ## Cosa farai • Propre et gérer le plan directeur de production (MPS) du site et assurer des plans d'approvisionnement optimisés et réalisables alignés sur la demande et la capacité. • Diriger la planification des capacités à moyen et à long terme, l'analyse des scénarios et l'évaluation des risques. • Conduire l'optimisation des stocks et maintenir des paramètres de planification précis et des données de référence (temps de pointe, stocks de sécurité, MOQ, BOM). • Collaborer avec les services d'approvisionnement et de logistique pour assurer l'état de préparation matérielle et atténuer les risques de disponibilité. • Diriger des réunions de planification interfonctionnelles et fournir des contributions pour les S-P, les cycles budgétaires et les rapports de direction. • Développer et suivre la planification des ICR, la normalisation des processus et les améliorations numériques championnes (SAP, IBP). • Diriger, coacher et développer l'équipe de planification des approvisionnements, en favorisant une culture de collaboration et de performance élevée. ## Requisiti • 5-10 ans d'expérience en chaîne d'approvisionnement (Pharma préféré; automobile ou biens de consommation également acceptable) • Forte expertise en planification • 2-3 ans d'expérience en leadership d'équipe (p. ex., superviseur, chef d'équipe) • Bachelor ou Master en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (préféré) ou domaines connexes • SAP (PP/MM) ou systèmes similaires • MPS/MRP, inventaire et planification des capacités • Anglais : couramment, allemand : avantage ## Chi siamo Chez Lonza, notre personnel est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Ihre Aufgaben: • Mitarbeit bei der Durchführung und Überwachung von mikrobiellen Fermentationsprozessen sowie Biokonjugationsreaktionen im GMP-Betrieb. • Unterstützung im Downstream Processing (DSP): Mitarbeit bei Aufarbeitungsschritten wie Primary Recovery, Filtration, Chromatographie und Formulierung biologischer Wirkstoffe. • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung, Überprüfung und Pflege von Batch-Records, SOPs und weiteren GMP-relevanten Dokumenten. • Mitarbeit bei der Auswertung von Prozessdaten und Unterstützung bei Abweichungsberichten (Deviations) und Change Controls. • Unterstützung des Teams bei der Optimierung von Betriebsabläufen und der Implementierung von Prozessverbesserungen. • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Funktionen wie Quality, Engineering und Supply Chain. Was wir suchen: • Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/FH/HF) in Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmazie, Pharmatechnologie, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar. • Interesse an biologischen Produktionsprozessen, Downstream Processing und dem pharmazeutischen GMP-Umfeld. • Selbständige, strukturierte und sehr gut organisierte Arbeitsweise. • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Über Lonza: Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.en: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence. Role Purpose: The Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence is critical for driving and overseeing the successful execution of strategic Quality Compliance programs/projects in alignment with the LGQ, IT, Operations, and the Quality Enabling Functions. This role is responsible for Lonza Quality Plan preparation and governance, managing the overall Compliance & Risk Management planning and reporting processes, facilitating Compliance, cross functional, and Global Quality Councils and serves as the touchpoint for to the leadership communications. The role serves as an ambassador and change agent for Compliance and Quality Excellence strategy and execution, in alignment with Lonza strategic imperatives, across platforms, functions, and regions. Key Responsibilities: Risk Management Framework Governance: • Lead the governance framework providing guidance and support to managers across platforms and functions. • Develops content for and facilitates strategic monthly leadership team meetings, as may be required. • Supports development and monitoring of global Quality Councils, including action tracking/minutes and Quality Plans. • Oversees Compliance programs/projects from initiation through to completion. • Monitors program/project progress and performance, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes. • Establishes/maintains project management standards and methodologies within in alignment with the One Lonza Vision Operates as SME/SPOC for competency areas, supporting troubleshooting, audits & inspections, etc. as required. • Support sites and business platforms during regulatory inspections, complex investigations, and escalated compliance topics, as needed. • Works closely with Compliance Head to complex manage escalations and address Executive leadership needs. Global Execution of Quality Compliance & QMS Strategy: • Ensure operational execution of all strategic initiatives within Compliance & QMS, driving standardization and performance improvement. • Drive and lead the implementation of change management within operational planning to embed new processes, systems, and ways of working. • Oversee the development, monitoring, and reporting of the Lonza Quality Plan, ensuring visibility and accountability across functions. • Monitor and drive global improvements benchmarking, and proactive risk mitigation. Data Analysis and Reporting: • Prepare and present detailed reports on strategic Quality program/project performance, risk status and operational metrics. • Manage the business reporting process (e.g., weekly huddle reports, monthly Quality reports, quarterly batch release review, etc.) • Responsible for development of Quality KPI and KQI targets and monitors performance monthly (or as may be required based on projects, priorities). Stakeholder Engagement: • Build strong relationships with Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Finance, and platform/site leadership teams. • Use indirect leadership to drive decision-making and alignment in a matrixed global environment. • Facilitate executive-level discussions, ensuring balance between strategic priorities and operational realities. • Continuously influence stakeholders to maintain focus on long-term Quality Excellence goals. Skills: • Strong leadership and team management skills. • Excellent project management skills. • Excellent Quality and Compliance experience. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. • High attention to detail and organizational skills. • Superior communication and interpersonal skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools. Key Requirements: Qualifications & Experience • BSc or Masters degree in life science. • PMP Certification ICH Q8,9,10 Proficiency preferred. • Demonstrated success in managing large-scale, complex programs. • Experience in developing and implementing risk management frameworks. • Multisite leadership and Growth Projects experience • Successful track record with Health Authorities inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.). • Experience in managing complex multi-functional teams in a multinational business environment. • Experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-national environment. • Able to work in a matrix-team structure. • Strong and proven leadership capabilities. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Führen Sie die Umsetzung des Change Managements innerhalb der Betriebsplanung, um neue Prozesse, Systeme und Arbeitsweisen einzubetten. - Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwicklung, Überwachung und Berichterstattung des Qualitätsplans von Lonza, um die Sichtbarkeit und Rechenschaftspflicht in allen Funktionen zu gewährleisten. - Überwachen und beschleunigen globale Verbesserungen Benchmarking und proaktive Risikominderung. - Data Analysis and Reporting: - Detaillierte Berichte über strategische Qualitätsprogramm/Projektleistung, Risikostatus und operationelle Metriken erstellen und präsentieren. - Erleichterung der geschäftsführenden Diskussionen und Gewährleistung des Gleichgewichts zwischen strategischen Prioritäten und operativen Realitäten. - Kontinuierlich Einfluss auf die Stakeholder, um den Fokus auf langfristige Ziele von Quality Excellence zu halten. Requisiti ### Fähigkeiten - Starke Führungs- und Teammanagementfähigkeiten. - Ausgezeichnete Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. - Ausgezeichnete Qualität und Compliance Erfahrung. - Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. - Hohe Aufmerksamkeit auf Detail und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. - Überlegene Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. - Vorteile in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) und Datenanalyse-Tools. ### Grundvoraussetzungen: Qualifications & Experience - BSc oder Masters in Life Sciences. - PMP Zertifizierung ICH Q8,9,10 Proficiency bevorzugt. - Erprobter Erfolg bei der Verwaltung von großräumigen, komplexen Programmen. - Erfahrungen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Risikomanagement-Rahmen. - Erfahrung in Führungs- und Wachstumsprojekten - Erfolgreiche Erfolgsbilanz mit Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden (FDA, EMA, etc.). - Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer multifunktionaler Teams in einem multinationalen Geschäftsumfeld. - Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem multikulturellen und multinationalen Umfeld. - In einer Matrix-Dampf-Struktur arbeiten. - Starke und bewährte Führungsfähigkeiten. Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza haben jeden Tag einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Für uns ist dies nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie opérant sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Nous cherchons un responsable mondial de la conformité et de la gestion des risques Gouvernance et renseignement. ## Mansioni ### Rôle But Le responsable mondial de la conformité et de la gestion des risques La gouvernance et l'intelligence sont essentielles pour diriger et superviser l'exécution réussie des programmes/projets stratégiques de conformité à la qualité, conformément aux LGQ, aux TI, aux opérations et aux fonctions habilitantes de qualité. Ce rôle est responsable de la préparation et de la gouvernance du Plan qualité de Lonza, de la gestion des processus globaux de planification et de rapport en matière de conformité et de gestion des risques, de la facilitation de la conformité, des conseils de qualité interfonctionnels et mondiaux et sert de point de contact pour les communications de leadership. Ce rôle sert d'ambassadeur et d'agent de changement pour la stratégie et l'exécution d'excellence en matière de conformité et de qualité, conformément aux impératifs stratégiques de Lonza, dans toutes les plateformes, fonctions et régions. ### Principales responsabilités - Cadre de gestion du risque Gouvernance : - Diriger le cadre de gouvernance en fournissant des conseils et du soutien aux gestionnaires dans toutes les plateformes et fonctions. - Élaborer du contenu pour les réunions d'équipes de leadership stratégiques mensuelles et en faciliter la tenue, au besoin. - Appuie le développement et le suivi des conseils mondiaux de la qualité, y compris le suivi des actions/minutes et les plans de qualité. - Supervise les programmes et les projets de conformité depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur achèvement. - Surveille l'avancement et le rendement des programmes et des projets, en veillant à ce que les résultats soient fournis en temps opportun et de qualité. - Établir/maintenir des normes et des méthodologies de gestion de projet en conformité avec la vision One Lonza fonctionne en tant que PME/SPOC pour les domaines de compétence, appuyer le dépannage, les audits et les inspections, etc., au besoin. - Soutenir les sites et les plates-formes d'affaires pendant les inspections réglementaires, les enquêtes complexes et les questions de conformité accrues, au besoin. - Collabore étroitement avec le chef de la conformité pour gérer les escalades complexes et répondre aux besoins de leadership de la haute direction. - Mise en oeuvre globale de la conformité à la qualité et de la stratégie du SGQ : - Assurer l'exécution opérationnelle de toutes les initiatives stratégiques au sein de la conformité et du SGQ, favorisant la normalisation et l'amélioration des performances. - Diriger et diriger la mise en oeuvre de la gestion du changement dans la planification opérationnelle afin d'intégrer de nouveaux processus, systèmes et méthodes de travail. - Superviser l'élaboration, le suivi et l'établissement de rapports sur le Plan qualité de Lonza, en assurant la visibilité et la responsabilisation de toutes les fonctions. - Surveiller et orienter l'analyse comparative des améliorations à l'échelle mondiale et l'atténuation proactive des risques. - Analyse des données et rapports : - Préparer et présenter des rapports détaillés sur le rendement stratégique du programme/projet Qualité, l'état des risques et les paramètres opérationnels. - Gérer le processus de rapports d'activités (p. ex. rapports hebdomadaires, rapports mensuels sur la qualité, examen trimestriel des rejets par lots, etc.) - Responsable de l'élaboration des cibles de l'ICP et de l'ICQ de qualité et surveille le rendement tous les mois (ou selon les besoins en fonction des projets, des priorités). - Engagement des intervenants : - Établir des relations solides avec les équipes de direction de la qualité mondiale, des affaires réglementaires, des opérations, des finances et des plateformes/site. - Utiliser le leadership indirect pour stimuler la prise de décisions et l'alignement dans un environnement mondial matricié. - Faciliter les discussions au niveau de la direction, en assurant un équilibre entre les priorités stratégiques et les réalités opérationnelles. - Influencer continuellement les intervenants sur les objectifs à long terme d'excellence en matière de qualité. ## Requisiti ### Compétences - Fort leadership et compétences en gestion d'équipe. - Excellentes compétences en gestion de projet. - Excellente expérience de qualité et de conformité. - Fortes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes. - Une grande attention au détail et aux compétences organisationnelles. - Compétences supérieures en communication et relations interpersonnelles. - Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) et outils d'analyse de données. ### Principales exigences : Qualifications et expérience - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la vie. - Certification PMP ICH Q8,9,10 Compétence préférée. - Le succès démontré dans la gestion de programmes complexes à grande échelle. - Expérience dans l ' élaboration et la mise en œuvre de cadres de gestion des risques. - Expérience de leadership multisite et de projets de croissance - Expérience réussie avec les inspections des autorités sanitaires (ADF, EMA, etc.). - Expérience dans la gestion d'équipes multifonctionnelles complexes dans un environnement commercial multinational. - Expérience de travail dans un environnement multiculturel et multinational. - Peut fonctionner dans une structure matricielle. - Des capacités de leadership solides et éprouvées. ## Cosa offriamo Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. ## Contatto Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. An unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir für den Bereich der chemischen Pharmaproduktion Visp MES(Syncade)/DCS(DeltaV) Spezialisten. Was auf Sie wartet: • Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur. • Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld. • Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben: • Sie erstellen, testen und optimieren den automatisierten Produktionsablauf. • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem zuständigen Anlageteam (Chemiker, Anlage- und Automationsingenieur, QA Manager, Anlagemeister) während der Planungsphase und der Produktion. • Erstellung und Anpassung von Rezepturen im DeltaV und MES. • Teilnahme an Risiko- und Prozessabweichungsanalysen. • In Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen stellen Sie die cGMP-gerechte Dokumentation sicher. • Sie verbessern ständig Abläufe und Prozesse unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsanforderungen. • Sie erkennen Risiken in Bezug auf Sicherheit oder Compliance/GMP, thematisieren diese und arbeiten mit bei deren Behebung. Was wir suchen: • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Verfahrenstechnik und Produktion und/oder im Erstellen von DeltaV und MES Rezepten (Syncade). • Bereitschaft zur internen Weiterbildung zum MES/DeltaV Spezialisten. • Die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen und den Teammitgliedern gehört zu Ihren Stärken • Sie sind ein Planungs- und Organisationstalent bei komplexen Projekten und haben eine stets lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise • Sie sprechen deutsch und haben Grundkenntnisse in Englisch. Wir bieten attraktive Benefits sowie ein umfassendes Relocation-Paket für talentierte neue Mitarbeitende. Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Lonza Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, qui opère sur trois continents. Nous sommes actifs dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formules magiques pour notre fonctionnement. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui travaillent ensemble et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés gèrent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail que nous voulons partager. Description du travail Nous sommes à la recherche de spécialistes Viège MES(Syncade)/DCS(DeltaV) sur notre site à Viège. ## Ce qui vous attend : - Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique. - Oui. Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique. - Une variété d'avantages, selon la fonction et l'emplacement. ## Vos tâches : - Vous créez, testez et optimisez le processus de production automatisé. - Coopération étroite avec l'équipe d'usine concernée (chimistes, ingénieurs d'usine et d'automatisation, gestionnaires d'AQ, maîtres d'usine) pendant la phase de planification et la production. - Création et adaptation de recettes dans DeltaV et MES. - Participation aux analyses des risques et des écarts de processus. - En collaboration avec d'autres ministères, s'assurer que la documentation est conforme aux BPF. - Oui. Ils améliorent constamment les processus et les processus dans le respect des exigences de sécurité, d'hygiène, d'environnement et de qualité. - Oui. Vous reconnaissez les risques liés à la sécurité ou à la conformité/BPF, vous les traitez et vous travaillez avec leur élimination. - Oui. Ce que nous recherchons: - Expérience trouvée dans l'ingénierie et la production de process et/ou dans la création de recettes DeltaV et MES (Syncade). - Formation interne des spécialistes du MES/DeltaV. - La collaboration avec les interfaces internes et les membres de l'équipe est l'une de vos forces - vous êtes une institution de planification et d'organisation dans des projets complexes et avez une opération toujours orientée vers la solution - vous parlez allemand et avez des connaissances de base en anglais. - Oui. Ce que nous offrons Nous offrons des avantages intéressants ainsi qu'un ensemble complet de réinstallation pour les nouveaux employés talentueux. À propos de Lonza Chez Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent ensemble tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : coopération, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de chaque individu, petits ou grands, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et nous aimerions vous laisser participer. L'innovation prospère lorsque les personnes d'origines les plus diverses apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire les idées révolutionnaires de nos clients en thérapies pratiques, nous sommes heureux de vous accueillir à bord. ## Kontatto Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Postuler maintenant Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication pharmaceutique et biotechnologique. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Lonza è leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, che opera in tre continenti. Siamo attivi nella scienza, ma non ci sono formule magiche per come lavoriamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante sono dipendenti di talento che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo condividere. A Visp, un chimico ambientale sta cercando 80-100% (m/w/d). In qualità di chimico ambientale, siete responsabili della consulenza e del supporto agli impianti di produzione ChemPharma e BioPharma nel campo della protezione ambientale e della sostenibilità. Essi valutano gli impatti ambientali di nuovi impianti di produzione e processi produttivi, assicurano la loro conformità legale e scrivono i rapporti di impatto ambientale necessari per l'ingresso della costruzione. Essi definiscono percorsi di smaltimento ecologicamente sani per i vari rifiuti e acque reflue degli impianti di produzione. È inoltre possibile eseguire progetti di Vision Zero nel campo della protezione ambientale e della sostenibilità dalla fase concept alla realizzazione. # Che# offrono - Una carriera agile e una cultura di lavoro dinamica - Un posto di lavoro integrativo ed etico - Programmi di remunerazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni - Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, ci si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali si può trovare anche in: assetstream.aspx (lonza.com) ## Le do attività - In collaborazione con gli ingegneri del progetto, si valuta l'impatto ambientale di nuovi impianti su aria di scarico, acque reflue, rifiuti, rumore e consumo di risorse. - No. Essi definiscono misure per ridurre al minimo gli impatti ambientali. - No. Riassumono i risultati di una relazione sull'impatto ambientale (UVB) per le autorità. - No. In collaborazione con l'azienda, si crea il concetto di gestione dei rifiuti con i bilanci di massa, nonché i requisiti di sicurezza e ambientale e i miglioramenti di processo raccomandati relativi. acque reflue e rifiuti. Essi consigliano e sostengono gli impianti di produzione di acque reflue e di smaltimento dei rifiuti (audit e recensioni dei campi) e definiscono le rotte di smaltimento per i rifiuti e le acque reflue. - No. Mantenete i dati di base per i processi di produzione nel database dello SME e partecipate a valutazioni di rischio, chiarimenti di incidenti e audit. - No. Realizzano in modo indipendente i progetti per raggiungere Vision Zero e gli obiettivi di sostenibilità e per segnalare i vari indicatori ambientali e le performance ambientali. - Forniscono foto ambientali (circa 4 settimane all'anno) e supportano la gestione degli eventi, la comunicazione e la chiarificazione delle cause negli incidenti ambientali. ## Requisiti - Un master completato nel campo della biologia, della chimica, dell'ingegneria chimica, dell'ingegneria ambientale o delle scienze ambientali - Trovata esperienza professionale nella produzione, nell'ingegneria, nella R&D / MSAT e/o nella protezione ambientale - Ottima conoscenza della conoscenza tedesca e della buona conoscenza dell'inglese - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale, scritta e interpersonale - Eccellente capacità organizzative (priorizzazione in ambiente di vita veloce) e anche un giorno lavorativo indipendente e preciso - esperienza Per noi questo non è solo un grande onore. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza viene dato rispetto e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente ragionevole. Lonza porta le persone che affrontano le sfide e sviluppano nuove idee per problemi complessi con la loro creatività nel settore Life Science. Insieme, contribuiamo a migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo dà loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: Descrizione Lonza is a world leader in life sciences, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there are no magic formulas for how we work. Our most important scientific solution are talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees manage their career independently. Because their ideas, whether big and small, improve the world. And this is the kind of work we want to share. At Visp, an environmental chemist is looking for 80-100% (m/w/d). As an environmental chemist, you are responsible for consulting and supporting ChemPharma and BioPharma production plants in the field of environmental protection and sustainability. They assess the environmental impacts of new production plants and production processes, ensure their legal conformity and write environmental impact reports necessary for the construction input. They define environmentally sound disposal routes for the various waste and waste water from the production plants. You can also run projects from Vision Zero in the field of environmental protection and sustainability from the concept phase to the realization. ## Cosa offriamo - An agile career and a dynamic working culture - An integrative and ethical workplace - Remuneration programs that recognize high performance - In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found in: assetstream.aspx (lonza.com) ## Le do attività - In cooperation with project engineers, you assess the environmental impact of new plants on waste air, waste water, waste, noise and resource consumption. - They define measures to reduce environmental impacts to a minimum. - They summarize the results in an environmental impact report (UVB) for the authorities. - In cooperation with the company, you create the waste management concept with mass balances as well as safety and environmental requirements and recommended process improvements related to. Wastewater and waste. - They advise and support the production plants in wastewater and waste disposal (campaign audits and reviews) and define the disposal routes for waste and waste water. - You maintain basic data for production processes in the EMS database and take part in risk assessments, incident clarifications and audits. - They independently implement projects to achieve Vision Zero and the sustainability goals and report on the various environmental indicators and environmental performances. - They provide environmental pict (approximately 4 weeks per year) and support event management, communication and Cause clarification in environmental incidents. ## Requisiti - A completed master's degree in the field of biology, chemistry, chemistry engineer, environmental engineer or environmental sciences - Found professional experience in production, engineering, R&D / MSAT and/or environmental protection - Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English - Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication skills - Excellent organizational skills (priorization in fast-life environment) as well as an independent and precise working day - experience For us this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. As we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is given and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally reasonable progress. Lonza brings people who take on challenges and develop new ideas for complex problems with their creativity in the Life Science sector. Together, we contribute to improving the lives of many people around the world. This gives them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.de:
## Über Lonza

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

## Stelle

Als Betriebs-/Anlagemeister (m/w/d) sind Sie zuständig für die technische und logistische Abwicklung von Produktionskampagnen in einem Produktionsbetrieb zur Herstellung von Biokonjugaten. Sie sind Mitglied eines interdisziplinären Teams und arbeiten in Projektteams mit, welche sich um Investitionen sowie Optimierungen von Abläufen, Tätigkeiten und Systemen kümmern.

## Ihre Aufgaben

- Einbringung in Planungs- und Engineering Phase von Projekten, um technische Vorgaben für die Anlagen einzuhalten und eine erfolgreiche Produktionskampagne sicherzustellen
- Organisatorische und betriebstechnische Betreuung, sowie Überwachung der Produktionskampagnen, zur Sicherstellung der Produktion und Sicherheit auch ausserhalb der normalen Arbeitszeit
- Erstellung von cGMP gerechter Dokumentation in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Anlageteamleiter, der Forschung/Entwicklung und den Betriebsbiotechnologen
- Anlagetechnische Instruktion und produktionsspezifische Ausbildung der Operatoren während der Produktion
- Kontrolle der lückenlosen Befolgung der Betriebsvorschriften und Herstellungsprotokolle, sowie Eingriff bei Abweichungen
- Unterstützung des Informationsaustausches und Kommunikation innerhalb der Betriebsgruppe
- Durchgehende Verbesserung von Anlagen, Abläufen und Prozessen (6S, Lean Six Sigma, KAIZEN) unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsanforderungen

## Was wir suchen

- Abgeschlossene technische Aus- oder Weiterbildung (Berufslehre, Höhere Fachprüfung, Bachelor, Master)
- Vorteilhaft wäre Produktionserfahrung bei der Herstellung von chemischen oder biotechnologischen Produkten, oder in der Lebensmittelindustrie
- Idealerweise erste Erfahrung im ISO- und / oder GMP-Produktionsumfeld
- Sie verfügen über Grundkenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, Word) und sind affin für elektronische Systeme und Anwendungen
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie Englischkenntnisse
- Bereitschaft zur Leistung von Pikettdienst muss vorhanden sein

## Was auf Sie wartet

- Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
- Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld
- Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

For our campus in the heart of the Swiss Alps, we are looking for a Senior QA Specialist, Supplier Management (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the management of locally used suppliers, ensuring that production-related suppliers are appropriately qualified and that their activities are monitored from a quality perspective.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Interface with the global Quality Compliance and Audit Management Team to ensure appropriate implementation of qualification outcomes at site level.

• Handling of supplier-related deviations, investigations, risk assessments, and CAPAs in coordination with global and local stakeholders.

• Ongoing monitoring and performance evaluation of locally used suppliers to ensure compliance with applicable quality requirements.

• Support of regulatory inspections and authority audits related to supplier quality at the site

• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Supply Chain Management, QC, and Regulatory Affairs.

What we are looking for:

• A technical diploma in a scientific or laboratory-related field or an academic degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry or related field.

• Ideally, you have already gained initial experience in a similar position.

• Strong understanding of GMP regulations and change control processes.

• Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.

• Familiarity with supply chains, raw materials, equipment, facilities and logistics is a plus.

• Excellent communication and teamwork skills (oral and written), with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Good team player, willing to learn and grow with the team

Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, big or small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be a part of. At the Visp site, we are looking for a plastics technician (m/f/d) to strengthen our workshops. ## What we offer - An agile career and a dynamic work culture - An inclusive and ethical workplace - Compensation programs that recognize high performance - In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family, and leisure. The full list of our global benefits can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi ## Tasks - Manufacturing, processing, and assembling plastic components and assemblies according to technical specifications or drawings - Preparing, loading, and operating machines and systems in plastics processing such as cutting, welding, gluing, thermoforming - Compliance with safety and quality regulations, especially when handling heat and pressure processes during plastic welding - Visual quality inspection of welds and post-processing ## Requirements - Qualified plastics technician, plastics welder, plumber, or plant and apparatus constructor specializing in piping - Experience in plastics processing, piping, and apparatus construction - Willingness to undergo continuous further training - Enjoyment of cross-departmental work as well as independent and flexible teamwork - Reliability, resilience, entrepreneurial action, and open, direct communication - German language skills in word and writing, English skills are an advantage Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a top priority, and we protect both our employees and our environment. For us, success means morally acceptable progress. People join Lonza to solve challenging and complex problems through creative and innovative approaches in the life sciences sector. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives around the world. The satisfaction that comes from making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Une aide au déménagement est disponible pour les candidats éligibles et leurs familles si nécessaire. Lonza est aujourd'hui une entreprise leader mondial dans le domaine des sciences de la vie, active sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans le domaine scientifique, mais il n'existe pas de formule magique pour la façon dont nous abordons notre travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est constituée par des employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées aidant d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés gèrent leur carrière de manière autonome. Car leurs idées, grandes ou petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Sur le site de Viège, nous recherchons un technicien en plasturgie (h/f/d) pour renforcer les ateliers. ## Ce que nous offrons - Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique - Un lieu de travail inclusif et éthique - Des programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent les hautes performances - En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous attendent de nombreux avantages dans les domaines du style de vie, de la famille et des loisirs. La liste complète de nos avantages mondiaux est également disponible sur : https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi ## Missions - Fabrication, traitement et montage de composants et d'assemblages en plastique selon des spécifications techniques ou des dessins - Préparation, chargement et utilisation de machines et d'installations de transformation des matières plastiques telles que la découpe, le soudage, le collage, le thermoformage - Respect des consignes de sécurité et de qualité, notamment lors de la manipulation des procédés de chaleur et de pression lors du soudage des plastiques - Contrôle visuel de la qualité des soudures et post-traitement ## Exigences - Technicien en plasturgie, soudeur plastique, installateur sanitaire, constructeur d'installations et d'appareils spécialisé en tuyauterie - Expérience dans la transformation des matières plastiques, la construction de tuyauteries et d'appareils - Volonté de suivre une formation continue - Plaisir à travailler de manière interdépartementale ainsi que travail en équipe indépendant et flexible - Fiabilité, résilience, esprit d'entreprise et communication ouverte et directe - Maîtrise de l'allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit, connaissances en anglais un atout Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif quotidien sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, cela représente non seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La manière dont nous atteignons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante pour nous que nos succès eux-mêmes. Chez Lonza, le respect est primordial et nous protégeons à la fois nos employés et notre environnement. Pour nous, le succès signifie un progrès moralement acceptable. Les gens rejoignent Lonza pour résoudre des problèmes complexes et stimulants grâce à des approches créatives et innovantes dans le domaine des sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui accompagne l'amélioration de la vie dans le monde entier. La satisfaction qui vient du fait de faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial de la fabrication pharmaceutique et biotechnologique. L'entreprise exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), en Suisse.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'assistenza al trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Lonza è ora un leader globale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Siamo nel campo della scienza, ma non esiste una formula magica per il modo in cui affrontiamo il lavoro. La nostra principale soluzione scientifica è costituita da persone di talento che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la propria carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, rendono il mondo un posto migliore. Ed è questo il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo prendere parte. In qualità di operatore dei servizi / addetto alla manutenzione tecnica (m/f/d) con lavoro a turni nel BioAtrium (Visp), sei responsabile della gestione e del monitoraggio di complessi sistemi di produzione biologica. Insieme ai tuoi colleghi risolverai guasti, eseguirai lavori di pulizia e manutenzione, lavorerai nell'area dei servizi pubblici e documenterai le fasi di produzione (ad esempio prelevando campioni di unità di pulizia). Anche in tempi frenetici mantieni una visione d'insieme e apprezzi lo stretto scambio con varie funzioni (biotecnologi, ingegneri operativi, QA, ecc.). ## Cosa offriamo - Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica - Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico - Programmi retributivi che riconoscono prestazioni elevate - Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, puoi aspettarti numerosi vantaggi in termini di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. Puoi anche trovare l'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali su: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi ## I tuoi compiti - Gestione dei servizi pubblici (servizi puliti, servizi neri, sistemi HVAC e acque reflue) - Riconoscimento, segnalazione, interpretazione e risoluzione di malfunzionamenti e deviazioni - Confronto delle fasi dei processi interaziendali (relazioni, dipendenze, processi) - Coordinamento di attività parallele - Riconoscimento e definizione delle giuste priorità ## Il tuo profilo - Formazione professionale completata (EFZ) oppure scuola tecnica (HF) nel settore farmaceutico/chimico o idrotermosanitario - artigianato e conoscenze tecniche - ottima conoscenza del tedesco parlato e scritto; La conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio: disponibilità a lavorare su turni (4 turni) e flessibilità nella pianificazione del lavoro ## Informazioni su Lonza I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Il modo in cui raggiungiamo i risultati aziendali è per noi altrettanto importante quanto i nostri stessi successi. In Lonza il rispetto è molto importante e tuteliamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente giustificabile. A Lonza vengono persone che accettano le sfide e usano la propria creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi nel campo delle scienze della vita. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro. Pronti a contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Allora candidati adesso! Lonza è un leader globale nella produzione farmaceutica e biotecnologica. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti di produzione a Visp (Vallese), Basilea e Stein (Argovia), in Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione In qualità di tirocinante (m/f/d) nel progetto MSAT Growth presso Lonza AG, acquisirai esperienza pratica in un ambiente biofarmaceutico altamente regolamentato e orientato alla scienza. Supporterai il team MSAT in iniziative focalizzate sulla crescita relative alla produzione di prodotti farmaceutici, all'ottimizzazione dei processi e alla gestione del ciclo di vita, contribuendo direttamente a progetti tecnici che supportano l'espansione aziendale e l'eccellenza operativa. Farai parte di un entusiasmante progetto Greenfield a Stein AG, in Svizzera, e supporterai la preparazione commerciale di un impianto di produzione asettica su larga scala per prodotti biologici. ## Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di lavorare con un team globale e contribuire a progetti ad alto impatto. - Mentorship e opportunità di sviluppo professionale. ## Mansioni In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con esperti MSAT e stakeholder interfunzionali. A seconda delle esigenze del progetto, le tue responsabilità potrebbero includere: - Supporto alle attività MSAT all'interno di un progetto di investimento di capitale per costruire e mettere in servizio unità produttive, garantendo la preparazione commerciale per l'impianto di produzione GMP. - Supporto alla qualifica di apparecchiature di produzione e camere bianche. - Preparazione di documentazione GMP, rapporti tecnici, presentazioni e documentazione di progetto per gli stakeholder interni. - Supporto nel trasferimento tecnologico, miglioramenti dei processi o attività relative allo scale-up. - Assistenza nel coordinamento di riunioni, workshop e follow-up di progetto. - Collaborazione con team interfunzionali come Produzione, QA, QC, Sviluppo e Ingegneria. - Contributo proattivo di idee per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, la standardizzazione e i miglioramenti dell'efficienza. - Conformità ai sistemi di qualità Lonza, ai requisiti GMP e agli standard di sicurezza. ## Requisiti - Laurea (Triennale o Magistrale) in un campo tecnico o scientifico come Ingegneria, Biotecnologie, Farmacia o un campo correlato. - Comprensione di base del processo di produzione di prodotti farmaceutici e dei principi GMP/cGMP. - Competenza in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e capacità di lavorare con documentazione tecnica (SOP, protocolli, rapporti). - Forti capacità comunicative, in grado di tradurre argomenti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e azionabili. - Approccio proattivo e positivo, attitudine al problem solving e capacità di assumersi la piena responsabilità delle aree assegnate. - Forte spirito di squadra con una mentalità pratica. - Ottime capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, nonché padronanza della lingua inglese; la conoscenza della lingua tedesca è un plus. ## Informazioni su Lonza In Lonza, le nostre persone sono la nostra più grande forza. Con oltre 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team connessi a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di Collaborazione, Responsabilità, Eccellenza, Passione e Integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale per migliorare milioni di vite, ed è questo il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando persone di ogni provenienza portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. In Lonza, valorizziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se sei pronto ad aiutare a trasformare le idee rivoluzionarie dei nostri clienti in terapie praticabili, non vediamo l'ora di darti il benvenuto a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?
descriptionByLocale.en: As an Intern (m/f/d) in the MSAT Growth Project at Lonza AG, you will gain hands-on experience in a highly regulated, science-driven biopharmaceutical environment. You will support the MSAT team in growth‑focused initiatives related to drug product manufacturing, process optimization, and lifecycle management, contributing directly to technical projects that support business expansion and operational excellence. You will be part of an exciting Greenfield project in Stein AG Switzerland and will support the commercial readiness of a large-scale aseptic manufacturing facility for Biologics. What you will get: Opportunity to work with a global team and contribute to high-impact projects. Mentorship and professional development opportunities. What you will do: In this role, you will work closely with MSAT experts and cross‑functional stakeholders. Depending on project needs, your responsibilities may include: Support of MSAT tasks within a capital investment project to build and commission manufacturing units, ensuring commercial readiness for the GMP manufacturing facility. Support the qualification of manufacturing equipment and clean rooms Preparation of GMP documentation, technical reports, presentations, and project documentation for internal stakeholders Support in technology transfer, process improvements, or scale‑up related activities Assistance in coordination of meetings, workshops, and project follow‑ups Collaboration with cross‑functional teams such as Manufacturing, QA, QC, Development, and Engineering Proactive contribution of ideas for process optimization, standardization, and efficiency improvements Compliance with Lonza quality systems, GMP requirements, and safety standards What we are looking for: University Degree (Bachelor or Master) in a technical or scientific field such as Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field. Basic understanding of pharmaceutical drug product manufacturing process and GMP/cGMP principles Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and ability to work with technical documentation (SOPs, protocols, reports) Strong communication skills, able to translate complex technical topics into clear actionable messages Proactive, positive approach, problem-solving attitude, and ability to take full responsibility for assigned areas A very strong team player with a hands-on mentality Very good verbal and written communication skills as well as proficiency in English is a must; German language skills are a plus. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Als Praktikant (m/w/d) im MSAT Growth Project bei der Lonza AG sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrungen in einem stark regulierten, wissenschaftsorientierten biopharmazeutischen Umfeld. la connaissance de l'allemand est un atout. ## À propos de Lonza Chez Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Our core values: collaboration, responsibility, excellence, passion and integrity, reflect who we are and how we work together. The ideas of each individual, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is exactly what we want you to be part of. descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Lonza è oggi un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nel settore delle Life Sciences con oltre 100 siti di produzione e uffici in tutto il mondo e circa 15.000 dipendenti a tempo pieno. Siamo attivi nel campo della scienza, ma non esiste una formula magica per il nostro approccio al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante sono i talenti dei nostri dipendenti, che lavorano insieme per sviluppare idee che aiutano altre aziende a aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo autonomo. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo fare parte. ## Mansioni Come Tecnico di Laboratorio nel campo della Spektroskopie/NMR, sei responsabile delle seguenti attività: - Sei responsabile del supporto analitico per R&D e produzione in tutto il sito di Visp - Lavori di routine come identificazione del prodotto e quantificazioni, partecipazione allo sviluppo e alla validazione delle procedure di prova e analisi di rilascio per la produzione nel settore ISO e GMP (good manufacturing practice). - Supporti la Spektroskopie Ottica (IR, UV/VIS, Rotazione Ottica) nelle aree di pulizia delle installazioni e sviluppo di metodi - Lavori strettamente con i colleghi della ricerca, produzione, sicurezza sul lavoro e qualità ## Requisiti - Hai una formazione come Tecnico di Laboratorio di Biologia o Chimica o un Bachelor in Chimica/Biologia/Biotecnologia - Eventualmente hai raccolto esperienza nel campo ISO e/o GMP - Hai buone conoscenze di MS-Office - Esperienze con software Bruker e ACD Labs sono un vantaggio - Sei autonomo e responsabile, hai buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra e apprezzi il lavoro interdisciplinare - Oltre al tedesco, ti esprimi anche in inglese o francese di base ## Cosa offriamo Le persone diventano parte di Lonza per risolvere problemi complessi e stimolanti nel campo delle Life Sciences attraverso approcci creativi e innovativi. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che deriva dall'avere un impatto positivo sul mondo intero. La soddisfazione di fare la differenza in modo significativo. ## Contatto Lonza è un leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda opera importanti impianti di produzione a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: Description Lonza is today a global leader in Life Sciences with over 100 production sites and offices worldwide and around 15,000 full-time employees. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for our approach to work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who work together to develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their careers independently. Their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of. ## Responsibilities As a Laboratory Technician in the field of Spectroscopy/NMR, you are responsible for the following tasks: - You are responsible for analytical support for R&D and production at the entire Visp site - Routine tasks such as product identification and quantifications, participation in the development and validation of test procedures and release analytics for production in the ISO and GMP (good manufacturing practice) area. - You support Optical Spectroscopy (IR, UV/VIS, Optical Rotation) in the areas of plant cleanings and method developments - Close collaboration with colleagues from research, production, occupational safety and quality assurance ## Requirements - You have a training as a Biology or Chemistry Laboratory Technician or a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology - Possibly first experience in the ISO and/or GMP environment collected - You have good MS-Office skills - Experience with Bruker software and ACD Labs is an advantage - You are independent and responsible, have good communication and team skills and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration - In addition to German, you can also communicate in English or French at a basic level ## What we offer People become part of Lonza to solve challenging and complex problems in the field of Life Sciences through creative and innovative approaches. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving life around the world. The satisfaction of making a meaningful difference. ## Contact Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.en: Description Lonza is today a global leader in Life Sciences, operating on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for our approach to work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their careers independently. Their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of. As a Logistics Specialist Bioconjugates, you are responsible for all logistical aspects of production campaigns in Bioconjugates (PCP/PCPSS). As a member of a project team, you collaborate with the project management, operational biotechnologists, and machine operators to prepare a logistics concept for a new production campaign in Bioconjugates. As the central point of contact for all logistical activities during the campaign, you are responsible for the procurement/acquisition of raw materials, consumables, machine parts, and their correct storage and provision for production, up to the shipment of finished products. It is crucial to have a clean inventory management and documentation, as well as control over a GMP-compliant logistics (cold chain) of critical stock items. ## What we offer - An agile career and a dynamic work culture. - An inclusive and ethical work environment. - A variety of benefits, depending on function and location. ## Responsibilities - Responsible for creating logistics concepts for assigned production campaigns in collaboration with the project team. - Responsible for the logistical support of the production campaign, from material requirements to restocking after the campaign, in compliance with GMP regulations. - First point of contact for the project teams regarding logistical questions. - Interface between the operation/project and the central plant logistics. - Responsible for timely and clean inventory management of project-specific and operational warehouses (consumables, raw materials, and equipment) and ensures cleanliness and order in their areas. - Responsible for the preparation, organization, execution, and follow-up of cold storage transfers, ensuring correct adherence to the cold chain. - Tends to critically examine operational processes and brings creative suggestions for improvement, while adhering to all safety, hygiene, environmental, and quality requirements. - Open to general tasks in the support group. ## Requirements - FA Logistics / EFZ Logistics / EFZ Chemical/Pharmaceutical Technologist - Experience in production, laboratories, or other logistics areas (ideally in the chemical or pharmaceutical industry) - Ideally experience in the GMP area - Secure MS-Office skills and preferably SAP knowledge - Very good German language skills in speech and writing; good English skills are an advantage - Teamwork ability and open and communicative personality - Social competence - Reliability and honesty ## About Lonza Our employees are our greatest strength. At over 30 locations on five continents, our globally connected teams work every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, responsibility, excellence, passion, and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. The ideas of each individual, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is what we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people of different backgrounds bring their unique perspectives. Lonza appreciates diversity and promotes an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to turn our customers' groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we are happy to welcome you aboard. Ready to shape the future of Life Sciences?

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial dans les sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. de bonnes compétences en anglais sont un avantage - Capacité à travailler en équipe et personnalité ouverte et communicative - Compétence sociale - Fiabilité et honnêteté ## À propos de Lonza Nos employés sont notre plus grande force. descriptionByLocale.en: Description Location: Visp (Switzerland) Relocation assistance is available upon request for eligible candidates and their families. Lonza is today a global leader in Life Sciences, operating on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for our approach to work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their careers independently. Their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of! As a Scientist for Sterility Testing QC, you are part of the Quality Control Microbiology at the Visp site and support various QC projects with a focus on sterility testing and verification activities in the GMP environment. You will work in a dynamic, highly regulated environment and make an important contribution to the quality and safety of our products. ## What we offer - An agile career in a leading global Life Sciences company - An inclusive, ethical, and diverse work environment - Performance-oriented compensation and recognition programs - A wide range of attractive benefits ## Your responsibilities - Participation in QC Microbiology projects with a focus on sterility testing and verification - Conducting verifications and routine sterility tests on Drug Products - Capturing, analyzing, and evaluating verification data - Identifying and assessing vulnerabilities, planning, implementing, and monitoring corrective actions - Creating verification plans, reports, and technical documentation - Participation in method development and verification - Supporting other departments in quality-related questions - Participation in laboratory organization (e.g., material management, weekly laboratory cleaning) - Active support of continuous improvement processes within QC Microbiology ## What we are looking for - Completed degree in a natural science field (BSc / MSc / PhD) with a focus on Microbiology, Biology, or a comparable qualification - Professional experience in the pharmaceutical industry, preferably in the Microbiology / Bioburden field - Experience with QC software systems such as MODA, LIMS, TrackWise, or comparable systems is a plus - Experience with QC isolator systems and their qualification is desirable - GMP knowledge is a plus - Experience in method development is a plus - Independent, reliable, and quality-conscious work style - Enjoyment of working in a dynamic, regulated environment - Very good German and English language skills ## About Lonza - For Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. Across over 30 sites on five continents, our globally connected teams work every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, responsibility, excellence, passion, and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. The ideas of each individual, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that is exactly what we want you to be part of. - Innovation thrives when people of different backgrounds bring their unique perspectives. Lonza values diversity and promotes an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to turn our customers' groundbreaking ideas into practical therapies, we are happy to welcome you aboard.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nei settori delle scienze della vita, operante su tre continenti. Sebbene lavoriamo nella scienza, non esiste una formula magica per farlo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più grande è costituita da persone talentuose che lavorano insieme, ideando soluzioni che aiutano le aziende a migliorare la vita delle persone. In cambio, permettiamo alle nostre persone di gestire le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano davvero il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo far parte. Stiamo cercando uno Scienziato Associato Principale (m/f/d) per unirsi al nostro team di Sviluppo della Cultura Cellulare Mammifera a Visp. Questo ruolo combina leadership scientifica con lavoro pratico in laboratorio, guidando le attività di sviluppo upstream e collaborando con team multifunzionali e clienti per fornire soluzioni di bioprocessing di alta qualità. ## Mansioni - Guidare, progettare ed eseguire attività complesse di sviluppo del processo upstream, inclusi studi a piccola scala (fino a 10 L), garantendo il rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza e generando i dati e la documentazione necessari per supportare il trasferimento tecnologico alle strutture pilota e GMP. - Agire come esperto di settore (SME) per la cultura cellulare CHO, fornendo guida scientifica, supporto alla risoluzione dei problemi e decisioni per team interni ed esterni. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni clienti solide attraverso una comunicazione trasparente e eccellenza scientifica. - Progettare, ottimizzare e implementare modelli robusti di scalabilità verso il basso e verso l'alto. - Redigere e revisionare documentazione di alta qualità, inclusi piani di studio e report di sviluppo. - Supportare le attività di formazione e promuovere la condivisione della conoscenza tra i team. - Contribuire all'innovazione continua, all'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e all'implementazione delle best practice. ## Requisiti - Laurea triennale con 7+ anni o laurea magistrale con 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore rilevante nello sviluppo del processo upstream mammifero. - Esperienza pratica con la cultura cellulare CHO, inclusi AMBR250/AMBR15, flaconi da scosse, bioreattori a tanica agitata e filtraggio a profondità. - Forte comprensione dei principi di scalabilità verso il basso e verso l'alto, risoluzione dei problemi di bioprocessing e trasferimento tecnologico. - Capacità provata di pianificare, coordinare ed eseguire esperimenti a scala di laboratorio in un ambiente dinamico e multifunzionale. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione; inglese tecnico richiesto. - Disponibilità a supportare le operazioni durante i weekend o i giorni festivi diverse volte all'anno. - Forte orientamento di squadra, capacità organizzative e mentalità problem-solving. ## Cosa offriamo Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo le nostre persone e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo che otteniamo non è un vero successo se non ottenuto in modo etico. Le persone vengono a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nel settore delle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che deriva dal migliorare la vita di tutti intorno a noi. La soddisfazione che deriva dal fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è un leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda opera grandi impianti di produzione a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for an Associate Principal Scientist (m/f/d) to join our Mammalian Cell Culture Development team in Visp. This role combines scientific leadership with hands-on laboratory work, driving upstream development activities and collaborating with cross-functional teams and customers to deliver high-quality bioprocessing solutions. Key responsibilities: Lead, design, and execute complex upstream process development activities, including smallscale studies (up to 10 L), ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards and generating the data and documentation required to support tech transfer to Pilot and GMP facilities. Act as subject matter expert (SME) for CHO cell culture, providing scientific guidance, troubleshooting support, and decision‑making for internal and external teams. Build and maintain strong customer relationships through transparent communication and scientific excellence. Design, optimize, and implement robust scale‑down and scale‑up models. Author and review high‑quality documentation, including study plans and development reports. Support training activities and promote knowledge‑sharing across teams. Contribute to continuous improvement, workflow optimization, and best‑practice implementation. Key requirements: BSc with 7+ years or MSc with 5+ years of relevant industry experience in mammalian upstream process development. Hands-on expertise with CHO cell culture, including AMBR250/AMBR15, shake flasks, stirred tank bioreactors, and depth filtration. Strong understanding of scaleup/scaledown principles, bioprocess troubleshooting, and tech transfer. Proven ability to plan, coordinate, and execute laboratory scale experiments in a dynamic, cross-functional environment. Excellent communication skills; technical English required. Willingness to support operations during weekends or public holidays several times per year. Strong team orientation, organizational skills, and problem solving mindset. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Heute ist Lonza ein globaler Anführer im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften und operiert auf drei Kontinenten. technisches Englisch erforderlich. - Bereitschaft, die Operationen während Wochenenden oder Feiertage mehrmals im Jahr zu unterstützen. - Starke Teamorientierung, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungsdenken. ## Was wir bieten Jeden Tag haben die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza eine positive Wirkung auf Millionen von Menschen.
